recipes.title: Turkish-Style Menemen
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp olive oil
1 small onion, diced
3 ripe tomatoes, diced
1 mild green chili, diced
1/2 tsp paprika
Salt and pepper to taste
5 eggs
2 tbsp crumbled feta
Crusty bread, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook the onion until soft, about 4 minutes.
Add tomatoes and chili; cook until the tomatoes break down, about 8 minutes.
Stir in paprika, salt, and pepper.
Crack the eggs directly into the skillet and stir gently so they scramble into the sauce.
Cook until the eggs are just set, 2 to 3 minutes.
Top with crumbled feta and serve hot with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Egyptian Ful Medames
recipes.ingredients:
2 cans (15 oz each) fava beans, drained
1/4 cup water
3 cloves garlic, minced
1/4 cup olive oil, divided
Juice of 2 lemons
Salt to taste
1 tomato, diced
Chopped parsley, for garnish
Warm pita bread, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Simmer the fava beans with the water and garlic in a saucepan over medium heat for 10 minutes, mashing some of the beans with a spoon.
Stir in half the olive oil, the lemon juice, and salt.
Spoon into bowls and top with diced tomato and parsley.
Drizzle with remaining olive oil.
Serve warm with pita bread for scooping.

recipes.title: Irish Boxty Potato Pancakes
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups grated raw potato, squeezed dry
1 cup mashed cooked potato
1 cup flour
1 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp salt
1 egg
1/2 cup milk
2 tbsp butter, for frying
recipes.instructions:
Combine raw grated potato, mashed potato, flour, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
Whisk in the egg and milk to form a thick batter.
Heat butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Spoon batter into the skillet to form pancakes and cook 4 minutes per side until golden.
Serve warm with butter or applesauce.

recipes.title: Welsh Cakes
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups flour
1/2 cup sugar
1 tsp baking powder
1/4 tsp salt
1/2 tsp mixed spice or cinnamon
1/2 cup cold butter, cubed
1/3 cup currants or raisins
1 egg
2 to 3 tbsp milk
recipes.instructions:
Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, and mixed spice in a bowl.
Rub in the cold butter with your fingers until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs.
Stir in the currants, then add the egg and enough milk to form a soft dough.
Roll the dough to 1/4 inch thickness and cut into rounds.
Cook on a lightly greased griddle over medium-low heat, about 3 minutes per side, until golden and cooked through.
Dust with sugar and serve warm.

recipes.title: Dutch Poffertjes
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup flour
1/2 cup buckwheat flour
1 tsp instant yeast
1/4 tsp salt
1 1/2 cups warm milk
1 egg
Butter, for the pan
Powdered sugar, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Whisk flour, buckwheat flour, yeast, and salt together in a bowl.
Whisk in warm milk and egg until smooth, then let rest 20 minutes until bubbly.
Heat a poffertjes pan or nonstick skillet with a little butter over medium heat.
Spoon small rounds of batter into the pan and cook 1 to 2 minutes, flipping once, until puffed and golden.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Liège-Style Belgian Waffles
recipes.ingredients:
2 1/4 cups flour
1 packet instant yeast
1/4 cup warm milk
2 eggs
3/4 cup softened butter
1/4 cup sugar
1/2 tsp salt
1 tsp vanilla extract
2/3 cup pearl sugar
recipes.instructions:
Dissolve yeast in warm milk and let sit 5 minutes until foamy.
Combine flour, eggs, butter, sugar, salt, vanilla, and the yeast mixture into a soft dough.
Knead briefly, then let rise in a warm spot for 1 hour.
Fold in pearl sugar and divide dough into 6 balls.
Cook each ball in a hot waffle iron for 3 to 4 minutes until deep golden and caramelized.
Serve warm as is or with fruit.

recipes.title: Swedish Thin Pancakes with Lingonberry Jam
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups milk
1 cup flour
2 eggs
2 tbsp melted butter
1/2 tsp salt
1 tbsp sugar
Butter, for the pan
Lingonberry or berry jam, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Whisk milk, flour, eggs, melted butter, salt, and sugar into a thin, smooth batter.
Let the batter rest 10 minutes.
Heat a lightly buttered nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Pour a thin layer of batter, swirling to coat the pan, and cook 1 to 2 minutes per side.
Stack the pancakes and serve rolled or folded with jam.

recipes.title: Danish Aebleskiver Pancake Balls
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups flour
1 tbsp sugar
1 tsp baking powder
1/4 tsp cardamom
1/4 tsp salt
1 1/4 cups buttermilk
2 eggs, separated
3 tbsp melted butter
Butter, for the pan
Powdered sugar and jam, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, cardamom, and salt in a bowl.
Whisk in buttermilk, egg yolks, and melted butter until smooth.
Beat egg whites to soft peaks and fold gently into the batter.
Brush an aebleskiver pan with butter and fill each well two-thirds full; cook 2 minutes, then turn each ball with a skewer to cook the other side.
Continue turning until golden and cooked through, about 6 minutes total.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve with jam.

recipes.title: Finnish Oven Pancake (Pannukakku)
recipes.ingredients:
3 eggs
1 1/2 cups milk
2/3 cup flour
2 tbsp sugar
1/4 tsp salt
3 tbsp melted butter
Berries and powdered sugar, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 400 F and place a buttered 9-inch baking dish inside to heat.
Whisk eggs, milk, flour, sugar, salt, and melted butter until smooth.
Carefully pour the batter into the hot baking dish.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes until puffed and golden brown.
Slice and serve warm with berries and a dusting of powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Russian Blini with Sour Cream
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup flour
1 cup milk
2 eggs
1 tbsp sugar
1/4 tsp salt
2 tbsp melted butter
Butter, for the pan
Sour cream and jam, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Whisk flour, milk, eggs, sugar, salt, and melted butter into a smooth, thin batter.
Heat a small buttered skillet over medium heat.
Pour a small ladle of batter, swirling to coat, and cook 1 minute per side until lightly golden.
Stack the blini between sheets of parchment as you go.
Serve warm topped with sour cream and jam.

recipes.title: Ukrainian Syrniki (Farmer's Cheese Pancakes)
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups farmer's cheese or well-drained cottage cheese
2 eggs
1/3 cup flour, plus more for shaping
3 tbsp sugar
1/4 tsp salt
1/2 tsp vanilla extract
Butter, for frying
Sour cream and honey, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Mix the cheese, eggs, flour, sugar, salt, and vanilla into a thick batter.
With floured hands, shape the mixture into small patties.
Heat butter in a skillet over medium-low heat.
Fry the patties 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Serve warm with sour cream and a drizzle of honey.

recipes.title: Filipino Tapsilog Breakfast Plate
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb thinly sliced beef sirloin
1/4 cup soy sauce
2 tbsp calamansi or lime juice
4 cloves garlic, minced, divided
1 tsp brown sugar
2 tbsp oil
3 cups cooked rice, cooled
3 eggs
Sliced tomato and cucumber, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Marinate the beef in soy sauce, citrus juice, half the garlic, and brown sugar for at least 30 minutes.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over high heat and sear the beef until browned, about 4 minutes; set aside.
In the same skillet, add remaining oil and remaining garlic, then stir in the cooled rice, tossing until fragrant and lightly toasted, about 5 minutes.
In another pan, fry the eggs sunny-side up.
Plate the garlic rice with the beef and a fried egg.
Serve with sliced tomato and cucumber on the side.

recipes.title: Indian Poha (Flattened Rice Breakfast)
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups thick poha (flattened rice), rinsed and drained
2 tbsp oil
1 tsp mustard seeds
8 to 10 curry leaves
1 small onion, diced
1 small potato, diced small
1 green chili, minced
1/4 tsp turmeric
Salt to taste
Juice of 1 lime
Chopped cilantro and roasted peanuts, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Rinse the poha briefly under water in a colander, then drain well and set aside to soften.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat and pop the mustard seeds, then add curry leaves, onion, potato, and green chili.
Cook until the potato is tender, about 8 minutes.
Stir in turmeric and salt, then fold in the softened poha until well combined and heated through.
Remove from heat and stir in lime juice.
Garnish with cilantro and roasted peanuts before serving.

recipes.title: Indian Upma (Semolina Breakfast Porridge)
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup coarse semolina (rava)
2 tbsp oil
1 tsp mustard seeds
1 small onion, diced
1 carrot, diced small
1 green chili, minced
8 curry leaves
2 1/4 cups water
Salt to taste
Chopped cilantro, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Toast the semolina in a dry skillet over medium heat until fragrant, about 4 minutes; set aside.
Heat oil in the same pan and pop the mustard seeds, then add onion, carrot, chili, and curry leaves; cook 5 minutes.
Add water and salt and bring to a boil.
Gradually stir in the toasted semolina, whisking to prevent lumps.
Cook, stirring, until thickened and the grains are tender, about 5 minutes.
Garnish with cilantro and serve warm.

recipes.title: Besan Chilla Chickpea Pancakes
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups chickpea flour (besan)
1 1/4 cups water
1 small onion, finely diced
1 tomato, finely diced
1 green chili, minced
1/4 tsp turmeric
1/2 tsp ground coriander
Salt to taste
Chopped cilantro
Oil, for cooking
recipes.instructions:
Whisk chickpea flour with water until smooth and lump-free; the batter should be pourable.
Stir in onion, tomato, chili, turmeric, coriander, salt, and cilantro.
Heat a lightly oiled nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Pour a ladle of batter and spread into a thin round; drizzle a little oil around the edges.
Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden and set.
Serve warm with chutney or yogurt.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Egg Hoppers
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups rice flour
1 tsp instant yeast
1 tsp sugar
1 cup warm water
1 cup coconut milk
Salt to taste
5 eggs
Oil, for the pan
recipes.instructions:
Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water and let sit 10 minutes until foamy.
Whisk in rice flour, coconut milk, and salt to form a thin batter, then cover and let ferment in a warm spot 2 hours.
Heat a small rounded hopper pan or nonstick skillet over medium heat and swirl in a ladle of batter, coating the sides.
Crack an egg into the center, cover, and cook until the edges are crisp and lacy and the egg is set, about 4 minutes.
Repeat with remaining batter and eggs.
Serve warm as is or with a simple chili relish.

recipes.title: South Indian Rava Dosa
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup semolina (rava)
1/2 cup rice flour
1/4 cup flour
2 1/2 cups water
Salt to taste
1 small onion, finely diced
1 green chili, minced
1 tsp black peppercorns, cracked
Oil, for cooking
recipes.instructions:
Whisk semolina, rice flour, flour, water, and salt into a very thin, pourable batter; let rest 20 minutes.
Stir in onion, chili, and cracked pepper.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat and lightly oil it.
Pour the batter from the edges inward to form a lacy round, drizzling a little oil on top.
Cook until golden and crisp, about 3 minutes, then flip briefly to finish.
Serve hot with coconut chutney or sambar.

recipes.title: Lebanese Manakish Za'atar Flatbread
recipes.ingredients:
2 1/2 cups flour
1 tsp instant yeast
1 tsp sugar
1 tsp salt
1 cup warm water
2 tbsp olive oil
1/4 cup za'atar
3 tbsp olive oil, for topping
recipes.instructions:
Mix flour, yeast, sugar, and salt in a bowl, then stir in warm water and olive oil to form a soft dough.
Knead 5 minutes until smooth, then let rise, covered, for 1 hour.
Divide dough into 3 rounds and roll each into a flat disk about 1/4 inch thick.
Stir za'atar with the topping olive oil to make a paste and spread over each round.
Bake on a hot baking sheet at 450 F for 8 to 10 minutes until the edges are golden.
Serve warm, cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Mexican Molletes (Open-Faced Bean and Cheese Rolls)
recipes.ingredients:
3 bolillo or crusty sandwich rolls, halved
2 tbsp butter, softened
1 1/2 cups refried beans, warmed
1 1/2 cups shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1 cup diced tomato
1/2 small onion, finely diced
1 jalapeño, minced
Chopped cilantro and lime wedges, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the broiler and arrange the roll halves cut side up on a baking sheet.
Spread each half lightly with butter and toast under the broiler 1 to 2 minutes until lightly golden.
Spread warm refried beans over each half and top generously with cheese.
Broil again until the cheese melts and bubbles, 2 to 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine tomato, onion, jalapeño, and cilantro for a quick fresh salsa.
Top the molletes with the salsa and serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Brazilian Pão de Queijo Bites
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup tapioca starch
1/2 cup milk
1/4 cup oil
1/2 tsp salt
1 egg
1 cup grated Parmesan cheese
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 400 F and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Heat milk, oil, and salt in a small saucepan until just simmering, then pour over the tapioca starch in a bowl and stir to combine.
Let cool slightly, then beat in the egg and cheese until a sticky dough forms.
Roll into small balls and place on the baking sheet.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes until puffed and lightly golden.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Brazilian Tapioca Crepes with Cheese
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups granulated tapioca (polvilho)
1/2 tsp salt
1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella or queso fresco
Butter, for the pan
recipes.instructions:
Moisten the tapioca granules with a splash of water and salt, rubbing between your fingers until it resembles damp sand and passes through a sieve.
Heat a dry nonstick skillet over medium heat and sprinkle a thin, even layer of tapioca into the pan.
Cook until the granules fuse into a solid crepe, about 2 minutes, then flip.
Sprinkle cheese over half of the crepe, fold over, and cook until the cheese melts.
Repeat with remaining tapioca.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Jamaican-Style Spinach and Scrambled Eggs
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp oil
1 small onion, diced
2 scallions, sliced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 small tomato, diced
1 Scotch bonnet or jalapeño, minced (optional)
5 cups fresh spinach
6 eggs, beaten
Salt and pepper to taste
Fried plantain, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook onion, scallions, and garlic until softened, about 4 minutes.
Add tomato and chili and cook 3 minutes more.
Stir in spinach in batches, cooking until wilted.
Pour in the beaten eggs and season with salt and pepper, stirring gently until just set.
Serve hot alongside fried plantain.

recipes.title: Ghanaian Tom Brown Porridge
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup roasted corn flour (or toasted cornmeal)
3 tbsp roasted soy flour or ground peanuts
3 cups water or milk
2 tbsp sugar or honey
Pinch of salt
Sliced banana, for topping
recipes.instructions:
Whisk the corn flour and soy flour with a cup of cold water or milk until smooth to make a slurry.
Bring the remaining liquid to a boil in a saucepan.
Slowly whisk in the slurry, stirring constantly to avoid lumps.
Simmer, stirring often, until thickened and smooth, about 8 minutes.
Stir in sugar and a pinch of salt.
Serve warm topped with sliced banana.

recipes.title: Nigerian Akara Bean Fritters
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups dried black-eyed beans, soaked and peeled
1 small onion, chopped
1 red chili, chopped
Salt to taste
2 tbsp water, as needed
Oil, for frying
recipes.instructions:
Blend the soaked, peeled black-eyed beans with the onion, chili, salt, and a splash of water into a thick, fluffy batter.
Whip the batter by hand for a couple of minutes to add air.
Heat about 2 inches of oil in a pot to 350 F.
Drop spoonfuls of batter into the oil and fry until deep golden and cooked through, 3 to 4 minutes, turning once.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve warm on their own or with bread.

recipes.title: Ethiopian Firfir Spiced Flatbread Scramble
recipes.ingredients:
3 tbsp oil
1 small onion, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp ginger, minced
2 tbsp tomato paste
1 tsp paprika
1/4 tsp cinnamon
1/4 tsp ground coriander
1 cup water
Salt to taste
4 whole wheat pitas or flatbreads, torn into pieces
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook onion until soft, about 5 minutes.
Stir in garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Add tomato paste, paprika, cinnamon, and coriander, and cook 2 minutes until fragrant.
Pour in water and salt, and simmer 5 minutes to form a thick sauce.
Add the torn flatbread pieces and toss until well coated and softened.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Australian Avocado Toast with Feta and Chili
recipes.ingredients:
6 slices sourdough bread
2 ripe avocados
Juice of 1 lemon
Salt and pepper to taste
1/2 cup crumbled feta
Chili flakes
Microgreens or arugula, for topping
recipes.instructions:
Toast the sourdough slices until golden and crisp.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Spread the mashed avocado generously over the toast.
Top with crumbled feta and a sprinkle of chili flakes.
Finish with microgreens or arugula.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Loco Moco
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
Salt and pepper to taste
2 tbsp butter, divided
2 tbsp flour
2 cups beef broth
1 tbsp soy sauce
3 cups cooked rice
3 eggs
recipes.instructions:
Shape the ground beef into 3 patties and season with salt and pepper.
Cook the patties in a skillet over medium heat, about 4 minutes per side; set aside.
In the same skillet, melt 1 tbsp butter and whisk in flour to make a roux; cook 1 minute.
Whisk in beef broth and soy sauce, simmering until thickened into a gravy, about 5 minutes.
In another pan, fry the eggs sunny-side up in remaining butter.
Plate rice topped with a patty, a fried egg, and a generous ladle of gravy.

recipes.title: Croatian Burek with Cheese
recipes.ingredients:
1 package phyllo dough, thawed
2 cups cottage cheese, drained
1 cup crumbled feta
2 eggs
1/4 cup melted butter, plus more for brushing
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 375 F and grease a round baking dish.
Mix cottage cheese, feta, eggs, melted butter, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Layer sheets of phyllo in the dish, brushing each with butter, letting edges overhang.
Spread the cheese filling over the phyllo, then fold the overhanging edges over the top, adding a few more buttered sheets on top.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes until deep golden and crisp.
Let cool slightly before slicing.

recipes.title: Georgian Khachapuri Boats
recipes.ingredients:
2 1/2 cups flour
1 tsp instant yeast
1 tsp sugar
1 tsp salt
3/4 cup warm water
2 tbsp olive oil
2 cups shredded mozzarella
1 cup crumbled feta
3 eggs
3 tbsp butter
recipes.instructions:
Mix flour, yeast, sugar, and salt, then stir in warm water and olive oil to form a soft dough.
Knead 5 minutes and let rise 1 hour until doubled.
Divide dough into 3 pieces and shape each into a boat with raised edges.
Fill each boat with mozzarella and feta and bake at 425 F for 12 minutes until the crust is golden.
Crack an egg into the center of each boat and bake 3 to 4 minutes more until the egg white just sets.
Top each with a pat of butter and serve immediately, stirring the egg into the cheese as you eat.

recipes.title: Norwegian Sour Cream Waffles with Berry Jam
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups flour
1/4 cup sugar
1 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp cardamom
1/4 tsp salt
2 eggs
2 cups buttermilk
1/2 cup melted butter
Sour cream and berry jam, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, cardamom, and salt in a bowl.
Whisk in eggs, buttermilk, and melted butter until smooth; let batter rest 10 minutes.
Heat a Nordic waffle iron and cook the batter in batches until golden, about 3 to 4 minutes each.
Keep warm in a low oven while cooking the remaining batter.
Serve with a dollop of sour cream and berry jam.

recipes.title: Austrian Kaiserschmarrn Shredded Pancake
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup flour
1 cup milk
3 eggs, separated
2 tbsp sugar, plus more for caramelizing
Pinch of salt
1/4 cup raisins
3 tbsp butter
Powdered sugar and applesauce, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Whisk flour, milk, egg yolks, sugar, and salt into a smooth batter; stir in raisins.
Beat egg whites to soft peaks and fold gently into the batter.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat and pour in the batter.
Cook until the bottom is golden, about 4 minutes, then flip in sections and cook the other side.
Using two forks, tear the pancake into bite-sized pieces directly in the pan and sprinkle with sugar, tossing until caramelized.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve with applesauce.

recipes.title: Hungarian Sweet Cheese Crepes (Túrós Palacsinta)
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup flour
1 1/4 cups milk
2 eggs
Pinch of salt
Butter, for the pan
1 1/2 cups farmer's cheese or ricotta
1 egg yolk
3 tbsp sugar
Zest of 1 lemon
Sour cream, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Whisk flour, milk, eggs, and salt into a thin, smooth batter.
Cook thin crepes in a lightly buttered skillet, about 1 minute per side; stack and set aside.
Mix farmer's cheese, egg yolk, sugar, and lemon zest for the filling.
Spread filling down the center of each crepe and roll up.
Warm the filled crepes briefly in a buttered skillet until heated through.
Serve with a dollop of sour cream.

recipes.title: Persian Kuku Sabzi Herb Frittata
recipes.ingredients:
6 eggs
2 cups chopped parsley
1 cup chopped cilantro
1/2 cup chopped dill
3 scallions, chopped
2 tbsp flour
1/2 tsp turmeric
Salt and pepper to taste
1/4 cup chopped walnuts
3 tbsp oil
recipes.instructions:
Whisk eggs with flour, turmeric, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Stir in parsley, cilantro, dill, scallions, and walnuts until well combined.
Heat oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat and pour in the mixture, spreading evenly.
Cover and cook until the bottom is set and golden, about 10 minutes.
Carefully flip using a plate and slide back into the pan to cook the other side, about 8 minutes more.
Slice into wedges and serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Israeli Sabich Pita
recipes.ingredients:
1 medium eggplant, sliced into rounds
3 tbsp olive oil
Salt to taste
3 pita breads
3 hard-boiled eggs, sliced
1 cup shredded cabbage or lettuce
1 tomato, diced
1/2 cup tahini sauce
Amba or mango pickle (optional)
recipes.instructions:
Brush eggplant slices with olive oil and season with salt.
Roast or pan-fry the eggplant until golden and tender, about 6 minutes per side.
Warm the pita breads and slice open to form pockets.
Fill each pita with roasted eggplant, sliced egg, cabbage, and tomato.
Drizzle generously with tahini sauce.
Serve with a spoonful of amba or mango pickle if desired.

recipes.title: Peruvian Tamales Verdes
recipes.ingredients:
3 cups fresh corn kernels
1/2 cup cornmeal
1/4 cup oil
1 small onion, chopped
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 cup chopped spinach
Salt to taste
1 lb shredded cooked chicken
Dried corn husks or banana leaves, softened
recipes.instructions:
Blend the corn kernels with cornmeal and a little oil until a thick paste forms.
Sauté onion and garlic in oil until soft, then stir in spinach and cook until wilted.
Combine the corn paste with the onion mixture and season with salt.
Spoon a portion of the corn mixture onto a softened husk, add a spoonful of shredded chicken, and fold into a packet, tying with string.
Repeat with remaining mixture and steam the tamales for 45 minutes to 1 hour until firm.
Let cool slightly before unwrapping and serving.

recipes.title: Colombian Cheese Arepas
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups pre-cooked white cornmeal (masarepa)
1 3/4 cups warm water
1 tsp salt
1 cup shredded mozzarella
1 tbsp oil, plus more for the pan
Butter, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Mix cornmeal, warm water, and salt in a bowl and let sit 5 minutes to hydrate.
Knead in the shredded cheese and oil until a smooth, pliable dough forms.
Divide into 6 balls and flatten into discs about 1/2 inch thick.
Heat a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat and cook the arepas 5 to 6 minutes per side until golden with a firm crust.
Split open and add a pat of butter while hot.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Cuban Tostada with Guava and Cheese
recipes.ingredients:
1 loaf Cuban or French bread, sliced lengthwise into 3 pieces
3 tbsp butter, softened
6 oz guava paste, sliced
6 oz cream cheese, sliced
recipes.instructions:
Preheat a griddle or panini press over medium heat.
Spread butter on the outside of each bread piece.
Layer guava paste and cream cheese inside each piece of bread.
Press on the griddle until the bread is golden and crisp and the filling is warmed through, about 3 to 4 minutes.
Slice and serve warm.

recipes.title: Puerto Rican Mallorca Sweet Bread Sandwich
recipes.ingredients:
3 mallorca sweet rolls or soft brioche rolls, split
3 eggs
Salt to taste
6 slices Swiss or American cheese
3 tbsp butter
Powdered sugar, for dusting
recipes.instructions:
Scramble the eggs in a lightly buttered skillet with a pinch of salt until just set.
Layer scrambled egg and cheese inside each split roll.
Butter the outside of each sandwich.
Griddle the sandwiches in a skillet or panini press until golden and the cheese melts, about 2 minutes per side.
Dust the tops lightly with powdered sugar.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Chinese Jianbing Savory Crepe
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup flour
1/4 cup cornstarch
1 1/2 cups water
3 eggs
3 scallions, sliced
Hoisin sauce
Chili sauce
1 cup crispy wonton strips or crushed crackers
Oil, for the pan
recipes.instructions:
Whisk flour, cornstarch, and water into a thin, smooth batter.
Heat a lightly oiled nonstick skillet or griddle over medium heat and pour a thin layer of batter, swirling to coat.
Crack an egg over the crepe and spread it evenly, then sprinkle with scallions.
Once set, flip and spread hoisin and chili sauce over the crepe side.
Sprinkle crispy wonton strips over the sauce and fold the crepe into thirds.
Slice in half and serve warm.

recipes.title: Japanese Tamagoyaki Rolled Omelet with Rice
recipes.ingredients:
6 eggs
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp mirin
1 tbsp sugar
Oil, for the pan
3 cups cooked rice
Pickled ginger and nori strips, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Whisk eggs with soy sauce, mirin, and sugar until well combined.
Heat a lightly oiled rectangular tamagoyaki pan or small skillet over medium-low heat.
Pour in a thin layer of egg mixture, and once mostly set, roll it up to one side of the pan.
Pour another thin layer, lifting the rolled omelet so the new layer runs underneath, then roll again; repeat until the egg is used up.
Slice the rolled omelet into pieces.
Serve alongside rice, pickled ginger, and nori strips.

recipes.title: Korean Japchae Sweet Potato Noodles
recipes.ingredients:
8 oz sweet potato glass noodles
1/2 lb thinly sliced beef
3 tbsp soy sauce, divided
1 tbsp sesame oil, plus more for tossing
2 tsp sugar, divided
2 carrots, julienned
4 oz shiitake mushrooms, sliced
4 cups fresh spinach
3 cloves garlic, minced
2 tbsp toasted sesame seeds
recipes.instructions:
Soak the glass noodles in hot water until softened, about 10 minutes, then drain and cut into shorter lengths.
Marinate the beef in 1 tbsp soy sauce, sesame oil, and 1 tsp sugar for 10 minutes.
Blanch the spinach briefly, then squeeze dry and season with a little soy sauce.
Stir-fry the beef until browned, then set aside; stir-fry carrots and mushrooms with garlic until tender.
Toss the noodles in a hot pan with remaining soy sauce, sugar, and a drizzle of sesame oil until glossy.
Combine noodles with the beef, vegetables, and spinach, tossing well, and top with sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Japanese Yakisoba Noodles with Pork
recipes.ingredients:
10 oz yakisoba noodles
1/2 lb thinly sliced pork
2 cups shredded cabbage
1 carrot, julienned
3 scallions, sliced
3 tbsp yakisoba or Worcestershire-style sauce
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp oil
Pickled ginger, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Loosen the yakisoba noodles under warm water and set aside.
Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat and stir-fry the pork until cooked through, about 4 minutes.
Add cabbage and carrot and stir-fry until just tender, about 3 minutes.
Add the noodles and toss with yakisoba sauce and soy sauce until evenly coated and heated through.
Stir in scallions.
Serve hot topped with pickled ginger.

recipes.title: Japanese Furikake Onigiri Rice Balls
recipes.ingredients:
3 cups cooked short-grain rice, warm
3 tbsp furikake seasoning
1/4 cup pickled plum (umeboshi) or pickled vegetables, chopped
2 sheets nori, cut into strips
Salt, for shaping
recipes.instructions:
Wet your hands with lightly salted water to prevent sticking.
Scoop about 1/2 cup of warm rice into your palm and make an indent in the center.
Add a small spoonful of chopped pickled plum or vegetables into the indent, then fold the rice around the filling.
Shape into a triangle or ball, pressing gently to compact.
Roll or wrap the bottom with a strip of nori and sprinkle the top with furikake.
Repeat with remaining rice and serve at room temperature.

recipes.title: Thai Larb Gai Chicken Salad
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground chicken
1/4 cup lime juice
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar
2 shallots, thinly sliced
3 scallions, sliced
1/4 cup chopped mint
1/4 cup chopped cilantro
2 tbsp toasted rice powder
1 red chili, minced
Lettuce leaves and cucumber, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Cook the ground chicken in a dry skillet over medium heat, breaking it up, until cooked through, about 8 minutes.
Whisk lime juice, soy sauce, and brown sugar in a large bowl.
Add the warm cooked chicken to the bowl along with shallots, scallions, mint, cilantro, toasted rice powder, and chili.
Toss well to combine and adjust seasoning to taste.
Serve warm or at room temperature with lettuce leaves for wrapping and cucumber slices.

recipes.title: Thai Som Tam-Style Green Papaya Slaw
recipes.ingredients:
4 cups shredded green papaya (or shredded green cabbage and carrot)
2 carrots, julienned
2 tbsp lime juice
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 red chili, minced
1/4 cup chopped roasted peanuts
1 cup halved cherry tomatoes
recipes.instructions:
Combine shredded papaya and carrots in a large bowl.
Whisk lime juice, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and chili in a small bowl to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the vegetables and toss well, lightly bruising the vegetables with a spoon to help them absorb the dressing.
Fold in cherry tomatoes and half the peanuts.
Let sit 10 minutes to marinate.
Top with remaining peanuts before serving.

recipes.title: Filipino Pancit Bihon
recipes.ingredients:
8 oz rice vermicelli (bihon)
2 tbsp oil
1/2 lb chicken breast, thinly sliced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 small onion, sliced
1 carrot, julienned
1 cup shredded cabbage
1/4 cup soy sauce
2 cups chicken broth
Lime wedges, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Soak the rice vermicelli in warm water until pliable, about 10 minutes, then drain.
Heat oil in a large skillet or wok and cook chicken until browned, about 5 minutes; set aside.
Sauté garlic and onion until fragrant, then add carrot and cabbage and cook 3 minutes.
Return chicken to the pan, add soy sauce and broth, and bring to a simmer.
Add the drained noodles and toss until they absorb the liquid and are tender, about 5 minutes.
Serve warm with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Filipino Sinigang na Baboy (Tamarind Pork Soup)
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb pork shoulder, cubed
6 cups water
1 onion, quartered
2 tomatoes, quartered
3 tbsp tamarind paste
1 daikon radish, sliced
1 cup green beans, trimmed
4 cups spinach or bok choy
Salt to taste
Steamed rice, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Simmer pork with water, onion, and tomatoes in a large pot, skimming any foam, for 30 minutes until tender.
Stir in tamarind paste until dissolved into the broth.
Add daikon and green beans and simmer until tender, about 10 minutes.
Stir in spinach and cook just until wilted.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve hot over steamed rice.

recipes.title: Indonesian Gado-Gado Vegetable Salad
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups green beans, trimmed
2 cups shredded cabbage
2 potatoes, boiled and sliced
1 cup bean sprouts
2 eggs, hard-boiled and halved
1 block firm tofu, cubed and fried
1/2 cup peanut butter
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp lime juice
1/2 cup warm water
1 clove garlic, minced
1 tsp brown sugar
recipes.instructions:
Blanch the green beans and cabbage separately until just tender, then drain.
Arrange the blanched vegetables, boiled potatoes, bean sprouts, eggs, and fried tofu on a platter.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, warm water, garlic, and brown sugar into a smooth sauce.
Drizzle the peanut sauce generously over the salad.
Toss gently before serving or serve sauce on the side.
Serve at room temperature.

recipes.title: Indonesian Nasi Goreng with Chicken
recipes.ingredients:
3 cups cooked rice, cooled
2 tbsp oil
1/2 lb chicken breast, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 shallot, sliced
2 tbsp sweet soy sauce (kecap manis)
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 red chili, minced
2 eggs
Sliced cucumber and tomato, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat and cook chicken until browned, about 5 minutes; set aside.
Sauté garlic, shallot, and chili until fragrant.
Add the cooled rice, breaking up clumps, and stir-fry until heated through.
Stir in sweet soy sauce and soy sauce, then return the chicken to the pan and toss well.
In a separate pan, fry the eggs sunny-side up.
Serve the fried rice topped with a fried egg and sliced cucumber and tomato.

recipes.title: Malaysian Mee Goreng Fried Noodles
recipes.ingredients:
10 oz fresh yellow noodles
2 tbsp oil
1/2 lb chicken breast, sliced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 cup bean sprouts
2 cups shredded cabbage
3 tbsp sweet soy sauce
1 tbsp chili sauce
1 tbsp soy sauce
2 eggs
Lime wedges, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a wok over high heat and cook chicken until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook 1 minute, then push everything to one side and scramble the eggs in the empty space.
Add cabbage and bean sprouts and stir-fry 2 minutes.
Add the noodles, sweet soy sauce, chili sauce, and soy sauce, tossing until well coated and heated through.
Toss everything together until combined.
Serve hot with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Singaporean Hainanese Chicken Rice
recipes.ingredients:
1 whole chicken breast and thighs, bone-in (about 2 lbs)
6 cups water
4 slices ginger, divided
3 cloves garlic, divided
2 scallions
2 cups jasmine rice, rinsed
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp sesame oil
1 cucumber, sliced
Soy-ginger dipping sauce, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Simmer the chicken with water, half the ginger, 1 clove garlic, and scallions until cooked through, about 30 minutes; reserve the broth.
Remove chicken and plunge into ice water briefly, then slice.
Sauté remaining ginger and garlic in a little oil, add the rice, and toast briefly.
Cook the rice in the reserved chicken broth using a rice cooker or covered pot until tender.
Toss the sliced chicken with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Serve the rice with sliced chicken, cucumber, and dipping sauce, with extra broth on the side.

recipes.title: Burmese Tea Leaf Salad (Lahpet Thoke)
recipes.ingredients:
1/3 cup fermented tea leaf paste (or finely chopped green tea leaves steeped and drained)
2 tomatoes, diced
1 cup shredded cabbage
1/4 cup toasted peanuts
2 tbsp toasted sesame seeds
2 tbsp fried garlic
2 tbsp fried split lentils or roasted chickpeas
2 tbsp lime juice
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 green chili, minced
recipes.instructions:
Toast peanuts, sesame seeds, and fried garlic in a dry skillet until fragrant, then set aside to cool.
Combine tea leaf paste, tomatoes, and cabbage in a large bowl.
Whisk lime juice, soy sauce, and chili in a small bowl.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss well.
Add the toasted nuts, seeds, and crispy garlic, tossing again just before serving.
Serve immediately for the best crunch.

recipes.title: Cambodian Beef Lok Lak
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb beef sirloin, cubed
3 cloves garlic, minced
2 tbsp soy sauce, divided
1 tbsp hoisin sauce
1 tbsp sugar
2 tbsp oil
4 cups shredded lettuce
2 tomatoes, sliced
1 red onion, thinly sliced
Juice of 2 limes
Black pepper, for the dipping sauce
recipes.instructions:
Marinate the beef with garlic, 1 tbsp soy sauce, hoisin, and sugar for 15 minutes.
Heat oil in a hot skillet and sear the beef in batches until browned but still tender, about 3 minutes; set aside.
Arrange lettuce, tomato, and red onion on plates.
Whisk lime juice, remaining soy sauce, and black pepper for a dipping sauce.
Top the salad with the seared beef.
Serve with the lime dipping sauce and steamed rice on the side.

recipes.title: Indian Chicken Kathi Rolls
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken breast, sliced into strips
1/2 cup plain yogurt
1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste
1 tsp paprika
1/2 tsp turmeric
1 tsp garam masala
Salt to taste
3 flatbreads or parathas
1 onion, thinly sliced
Chopped cilantro and lime wedges
recipes.instructions:
Marinate the chicken in yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, paprika, turmeric, garam masala, and salt for at least 30 minutes.
Cook the chicken in a hot skillet until charred in spots and cooked through, about 8 minutes.
Warm the flatbreads in a dry skillet.
Layer the cooked chicken, onion, and cilantro down the center of each flatbread.
Roll up tightly, wrapping the base in foil or parchment.
Serve warm with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Indian Pav Bhaji
recipes.ingredients:
2 potatoes, boiled and mashed
1 cup cauliflower, boiled and mashed
1 carrot, boiled and mashed
3 tbsp butter, divided
1 onion, finely diced
2 tomatoes, finely diced
2 tbsp pav bhaji masala or garam masala
1/2 tsp turmeric
Salt to taste
6 soft dinner rolls (pav)
Chopped onion and lime wedges, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Melt 2 tbsp butter in a large skillet and sauté onion until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes and cook until broken down, about 8 minutes.
Stir in pav bhaji masala and turmeric, then add the mashed potato, cauliflower, and carrot along with a splash of water.
Mash and simmer everything together until thick and well combined, about 10 minutes, seasoning with salt.
Split and toast the rolls in remaining butter on a griddle.
Serve the bhaji topped with a pat of butter alongside the toasted rolls, chopped onion, and lime wedges.

recipes.title: Indian Rajma Chawal (Kidney Bean Curry with Rice)
recipes.ingredients:
2 cans (15 oz each) kidney beans, drained
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, finely diced
1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste
2 tomatoes, pureed
1 tsp paprika
1/2 tsp turmeric
1 tsp garam masala
Salt to taste
3 cups cooked rice
Chopped cilantro, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and sauté onion until golden, about 8 minutes.
Stir in ginger-garlic paste and cook 1 minute.
Add pureed tomatoes, paprika, and turmeric, and simmer until the sauce thickens and the oil separates, about 10 minutes.
Add the kidney beans and a splash of water, then simmer 15 minutes, mashing a few beans to thicken the sauce.
Stir in garam masala and salt.
Serve hot over rice, garnished with cilantro.

recipes.title: Indian Palak Tofu Curry
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb spinach
1 block firm tofu, cubed
2 tbsp oil, divided
1 onion, chopped
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp ginger, minced
1 tomato, chopped
1/2 tsp turmeric
1 tsp garam masala
1/4 cup coconut milk or cream
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Blanch the spinach until wilted, then blend into a smooth puree.
Pan-fry the tofu cubes in 1 tbsp oil until golden on all sides; set aside.
Heat remaining oil and sauté onion, garlic, and ginger until soft.
Add tomato, turmeric, and garam masala and cook until the tomato breaks down, about 6 minutes.
Stir in the spinach puree and coconut milk, then add the fried tofu and simmer 8 minutes.
Season with salt and serve hot with rice or flatbread.

recipes.title: Nepali Chicken Momos
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground chicken
1 small onion, finely minced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp ginger, minced
2 tbsp chopped cilantro
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tsp sesame oil
Salt and pepper to taste
30 round dumpling wrappers
2 tomatoes and 1 red chili, for dipping sauce
recipes.instructions:
Mix ground chicken with onion, garlic, ginger, cilantro, soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, and pepper.
Place a spoonful of filling in the center of each wrapper, moisten the edges, and pleat closed into a pouch.
Arrange the momos in a lightly oiled steamer basket without touching.
Steam over boiling water for 12 to 15 minutes until the wrappers are translucent and the filling is cooked through.
Meanwhile, char the tomatoes and chili, then blend into a simple dipping sauce with salt.
Serve the momos hot with the dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Pakistani Chicken Karahi
recipes.ingredients:
2 lbs bone-in chicken pieces
1/4 cup oil
1 onion, sliced
4 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp ginger, minced
4 tomatoes, chopped
2 green chilies, slit
1 tsp ground coriander
1/2 tsp turmeric
Salt to taste
Chopped cilantro and julienned ginger, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a wide, heavy pan and sear the chicken pieces until browned, about 8 minutes.
Add onion, garlic, and ginger and cook until softened.
Stir in tomatoes, green chilies, coriander, and turmeric and cook until the tomatoes break down into a thick sauce, about 12 minutes.
Cover and simmer until the chicken is cooked through and tender, about 10 minutes, adding a splash of water if needed.
Season with salt.
Garnish with cilantro and julienned ginger, and serve with flatbread or rice.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Coconut Chicken Curry
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs boneless chicken thighs, cubed
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, sliced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp ginger, minced
10 curry leaves
1 tbsp curry powder
1/2 tsp turmeric
1 cinnamon stick
1 can (14 oz) coconut milk
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and sauté onion, garlic, ginger, and curry leaves until fragrant, about 5 minutes.
Stir in curry powder, turmeric, and cinnamon stick and cook 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook until lightly browned on all sides.
Pour in coconut milk and simmer, partially covered, until the chicken is tender and the sauce thickens, about 25 minutes.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve hot over rice.

recipes.title: Uzbek Beef Plov Rice Pilaf
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb beef stew meat, cubed
1/4 cup oil
2 onions, sliced
3 carrots, julienned
1 1/2 cups long-grain rice, rinsed
3 cups beef broth
4 cloves garlic, unpeeled
1 tsp ground coriander
1 tsp paprika
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a heavy pot and brown the beef on all sides, about 8 minutes; remove.
Sauté onions until deep golden, about 10 minutes, then add carrots and cook 5 minutes more.
Return the beef to the pot along with coriander, paprika, and salt, and stir well.
Spread the rinsed rice evenly over the top without stirring, then pour in the broth and nestle the whole garlic cloves into the rice.
Bring to a boil, then cover tightly and simmer on low for 30 minutes until the rice is tender.
Fluff gently and serve warm with the garlic cloves squeezed over the top.

recipes.title: Georgian Lobio Bean Stew
recipes.ingredients:
3 cans (15 oz each) red kidney beans, drained, liquid reserved
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, finely diced
4 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp ground coriander
1/2 tsp fenugreek (optional)
2 tbsp chopped walnuts
2 tbsp chopped cilantro
Salt to taste
Cornbread or flatbread, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and sauté onion until soft and golden, about 8 minutes.
Stir in garlic, coriander, and fenugreek and cook 1 minute.
Add the beans with a splash of their reserved liquid and simmer 15 minutes, mashing some beans to thicken.
Stir in walnuts and cilantro, and season with salt.
Simmer 5 more minutes until thick and fragrant.
Serve warm with cornbread or flatbread.

recipes.title: Turkish Lahmacun Flatbread
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups flour
1 tsp instant yeast
3/4 cup warm water
1 tsp salt
1/2 lb ground beef
1 small onion, grated
2 tomatoes, grated
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp tomato paste
1/2 tsp paprika
Chopped parsley and lemon wedges, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Mix flour, yeast, warm water, and salt into a soft dough; knead 5 minutes and let rise 45 minutes.
Combine ground beef, onion, tomatoes, garlic, tomato paste, and paprika into a spreadable mixture.
Divide dough into 3 balls and roll each very thin into an oval.
Spread a thin layer of the beef mixture edge to edge on each round.
Bake on a hot baking sheet at 475 F for 8 to 10 minutes until the crust is crisp and the meat is cooked.
Top with parsley and a squeeze of lemon, then roll up to eat.

recipes.title: Turkish Mantı Dumplings with Yogurt
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups flour
2 eggs
1/2 tsp salt
2 to 3 tbsp water
1/2 lb ground beef
1 small onion, grated
Salt and pepper to taste
1 1/2 cups plain yogurt
2 cloves garlic, minced
3 tbsp butter
1 tsp paprika
recipes.instructions:
Mix flour, eggs, salt, and water into a firm dough; knead until smooth and let rest 20 minutes.
Combine ground beef, grated onion, salt, and pepper for the filling.
Roll the dough thin and cut into small squares; place a small dab of filling in the center of each and pinch into little purses.
Boil the dumplings in salted water until they float and the filling is cooked, about 10 minutes; drain.
Stir garlic into the yogurt and spoon over the dumplings.
Melt butter with paprika and drizzle over the top before serving.

recipes.title: Greek Gigantes Plaki Baked Beans
recipes.ingredients:
3 cans (15 oz each) large white or butter beans, drained
1/3 cup olive oil, divided
1 onion, chopped
3 cloves garlic, minced
2 carrots, diced
2 cups crushed tomatoes
1 tsp dried oregano
1 bay leaf
Salt and pepper to taste
Chopped parsley, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 375 F.
Heat half the olive oil in a large ovenproof pot and sauté onion, garlic, and carrots until softened, about 8 minutes.
Stir in crushed tomatoes, oregano, bay leaf, salt, and pepper, and simmer 10 minutes.
Fold in the beans and remaining olive oil.
Transfer to the oven and bake uncovered 30 minutes until bubbling and slightly thickened.
Garnish with parsley and serve warm.

recipes.title: Cypriot Halloumi and Vegetable Wrap
recipes.ingredients:
9 oz halloumi cheese, sliced
3 large flatbreads or wraps
1 cucumber, sliced
2 tomatoes, sliced
2 cups arugula
2 tbsp olive oil
Juice of 1 lemon
1 tsp dried oregano
2 tbsp tzatziki
recipes.instructions:
Heat a dry skillet over medium-high heat and sear the halloumi slices until golden on both sides, about 2 minutes per side.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, and oregano to make a quick dressing.
Warm the flatbreads briefly in the skillet.
Layer arugula, tomato, cucumber, and seared halloumi on each flatbread.
Drizzle with the dressing and a spoonful of tzatziki.
Roll up tightly and slice in half to serve.

recipes.title: Lebanese Tabbouleh Salad
recipes.ingredients:
1/2 cup fine bulgur
1/2 cup boiling water
3 cups finely chopped parsley
1/4 cup chopped mint
3 tomatoes, finely diced
3 scallions, finely sliced
1/4 cup olive oil
Juice of 2 lemons
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Soak the bulgur in boiling water, covered, until tender and the water is absorbed, about 15 minutes; fluff with a fork and cool.
Combine the bulgur with parsley, mint, tomatoes, and scallions in a large bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper, then pour over the salad.
Toss well to combine.
Let sit 10 minutes for the flavors to meld.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Lebanese Fattoush Salad
recipes.ingredients:
2 pita breads, torn into pieces
2 tbsp olive oil, divided
4 cups chopped romaine
2 tomatoes, chopped
1 cucumber, chopped
4 radishes, sliced
3 scallions, sliced
1 tbsp sumac
1/4 cup olive oil
Juice of 1 lemon
recipes.instructions:
Toss torn pita with 2 tbsp olive oil and toast in a 400 F oven until crisp, about 8 minutes.
Combine romaine, tomatoes, cucumber, radishes, and scallions in a large bowl.
Whisk sumac, olive oil, and lemon juice for the dressing.
Toss the salad with the dressing just before serving.
Add the toasted pita and toss again briefly to keep it crisp.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Egyptian Koshari
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup brown lentils
1 cup rice, rinsed
4 oz small elbow macaroni
1/4 cup oil
2 onions, thinly sliced
2 cups crushed tomatoes
3 cloves garlic, minced
2 tbsp white vinegar
1/2 tsp chili flakes
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Simmer the lentils in salted water until just tender, about 20 minutes; drain and set aside.
Cook the rice and macaroni separately according to package directions; drain and set aside.
Heat oil in a skillet and fry half the sliced onions until deep golden and crisp; set aside for topping.
In the same oil, sauté garlic briefly, then add crushed tomatoes, vinegar, chili flakes, and salt, and simmer 15 minutes into a tangy sauce.
Layer rice, lentils, and macaroni in bowls.
Top generously with the tomato sauce and crispy fried onions.

recipes.title: Ethiopian Misir Wot with Flatbread
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups red lentils, rinsed
3 tbsp oil
1 onion, finely chopped
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp ginger, minced
2 tbsp tomato paste
1 tbsp paprika
1/2 tsp ground coriander
1/4 tsp cinnamon
3 cups water
Salt to taste
Flatbread, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and sauté onion until deep golden, about 10 minutes.
Stir in garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Add tomato paste, paprika, coriander, and cinnamon, and cook 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the lentils and water, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until thick and the lentils are fully tender, about 20 minutes.
Season with salt.
Serve warm with flatbread for scooping.

recipes.title: Nigerian Jollof Rice
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups long-grain rice, rinsed
1/4 cup oil
1 onion, chopped, divided
4 plum tomatoes, blended
3 tbsp tomato paste
1 scotch bonnet or serrano chili, minced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp thyme
2 bay leaves
2 1/2 cups chicken broth
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a large pot and sauté half the onion until soft.
Stir in tomato paste and cook 3 minutes, then add blended tomatoes, chili, garlic, thyme, and bay leaves, and simmer 15 minutes until thickened.
Stir in the rice, coating it well in the sauce.
Pour in the broth, season with salt, and bring to a boil.
Cover tightly and simmer on low for 25 to 30 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed, stirring gently once halfway through.
Fluff with a fork and serve hot.

recipes.title: Ghanaian Red Red Bean Stew with Fried Plantain
recipes.ingredients:
3 cans (15 oz each) black-eyed beans, drained
1/4 cup palm oil or regular oil
1 onion, chopped
3 cloves garlic, minced
2 tomatoes, chopped
2 tbsp tomato paste
1 chili, minced
Salt to taste
2 ripe plantains, sliced
Oil, for frying plantains
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and sauté onion until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic, tomatoes, tomato paste, and chili, and cook until thickened, about 10 minutes.
Stir in the black-eyed beans and a splash of water, and simmer 15 minutes until well combined.
Season with salt.
Meanwhile, fry the plantain slices in oil until golden on both sides.
Serve the bean stew hot with the fried plantains.

recipes.title: Senegalese Mafe Peanut Beef Stew
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs beef stew meat, cubed
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, chopped
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp ginger, minced
3 tbsp tomato paste
2 tomatoes, chopped
1/2 cup natural peanut butter
2 cups beef broth
2 carrots, sliced
1 sweet potato, cubed
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a heavy pot and brown the beef on all sides, about 8 minutes.
Add onion, garlic, and ginger and cook until softened.
Stir in tomato paste and tomatoes and cook 5 minutes.
Whisk peanut butter with broth until smooth, then pour into the pot along with carrots and sweet potato.
Cover and simmer until the beef and vegetables are tender, about 35 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and serve hot over rice.

recipes.title: South African Bobotie-Style Beef Bake
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, chopped
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp curry powder
1/4 cup chutney or apricot jam
1 slice bread, torn, soaked in 1/2 cup milk
1/4 cup raisins
2 eggs
1/2 cup milk
Bay leaves
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 350 F.
Heat oil and sauté onion and garlic until soft, then add ground beef and cook until browned, about 8 minutes.
Stir in curry powder, chutney, the soaked torn bread, and raisins, mixing well.
Transfer to a greased baking dish and smooth the top.
Whisk eggs with milk and pour evenly over the meat; lay a bay leaf on top.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes until the custard topping is set and golden, then serve with rice.

recipes.title: Kenyan Sukuma Wiki with Kale and Beef
recipes.ingredients:
1/2 lb ground beef
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, chopped
2 tomatoes, chopped
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 bunch kale, stemmed and shredded
Salt and pepper to taste
Ugali or rice, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a large skillet and brown the ground beef, about 6 minutes.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened.
Stir in tomatoes and cook until they break down, about 6 minutes.
Add the shredded kale in batches, cooking until wilted and tender, about 8 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve hot with ugali or rice.

recipes.title: Trinidadian Curried Chickpea Doubles
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups flour
1/2 tsp turmeric
1/2 tsp instant yeast
1/2 tsp sugar
1/2 tsp salt
3/4 cup warm water
Oil, for frying
2 cans (15 oz each) chickpeas, drained
1 onion, chopped
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp curry powder
Mango chutney, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Mix flour, turmeric, yeast, sugar, and salt with warm water into a soft, slightly sticky dough; cover and let rise 1 hour.
Meanwhile, sauté onion and garlic in a little oil, add curry powder, and cook 1 minute.
Add chickpeas and a splash of water, and simmer until soft, mashing some for a thicker texture, about 15 minutes.
Pinch off pieces of dough and flatten into small rounds.
Fry each round in hot oil until puffed and lightly golden, about 1 minute per side.
Sandwich the curried chickpeas between two fried rounds and top with mango chutney.

recipes.title: Peruvian Lomo Saltado
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb beef sirloin, sliced into strips
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp red wine vinegar
2 tbsp oil
1 red onion, sliced
2 tomatoes, sliced into wedges
2 cloves garlic, minced
3 cups frozen fries, baked crisp
3 cups cooked rice
Chopped cilantro, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Toss beef strips with soy sauce and vinegar and let marinate 10 minutes.
Heat oil in a hot skillet or wok and sear the beef quickly in batches until browned but still tender; set aside.
In the same pan, stir-fry onion and garlic until just softened, about 2 minutes.
Add tomatoes and cook briefly until slightly softened but still holding shape.
Return the beef to the pan along with the baked fries and toss everything together over high heat for 1 minute.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Peruvian Aji de Gallina Creamy Chicken
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs cooked chicken breast, shredded
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, chopped
3 cloves garlic, minced
2 tbsp aji amarillo paste (or blended yellow chili)
2 slices bread, crusts removed, soaked in 1 cup milk
1/4 cup chopped walnuts
1/4 cup grated Parmesan
Salt to taste
3 cups cooked rice and boiled potato slices, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and sauté onion and garlic until soft, about 6 minutes.
Stir in aji amarillo paste and cook 2 minutes.
Blend the soaked bread with its milk and the walnuts until smooth, then stir into the pot.
Add the shredded chicken and Parmesan, and simmer, stirring, until thick and creamy, about 10 minutes.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve over rice with boiled potato slices alongside.

recipes.title: Bolivian Beef and Potato Salteñas
recipes.ingredients:
2 1/2 cups flour
1/2 cup cold butter, cubed
1 tsp sugar
1/2 tsp salt
1/2 cup cold water
1 lb ground beef
1 onion, chopped
1 potato, diced small and boiled
1 tbsp paprika
1 tbsp flour
1/2 cup beef broth
1 egg, beaten, for brushing
recipes.instructions:
Rub butter into flour, sugar, and salt until crumbly, then stir in cold water to form a firm dough; chill 30 minutes.
Cook ground beef with onion until browned, then stir in paprika, flour, and broth to make a thick, saucy filling; fold in the boiled potato and chill until firm.
Roll the dough into rounds and spoon the chilled filling into the center of each.
Fold the dough over the filling and crimp the edges into a rope pattern to seal.
Brush with beaten egg and bake at 375 F for 25 to 30 minutes until golden.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Brazilian Feijoada-Style Black Bean Stew
recipes.ingredients:
3 cans (15 oz each) black beans, undrained
1/2 lb smoked sausage, sliced
1/2 lb pork shoulder, cubed
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, chopped
4 cloves garlic, minced
2 bay leaves
Salt and pepper to taste
3 cups cooked rice and orange slices, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a large pot and brown the sausage and pork over medium-high heat, about 8 minutes.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened.
Stir in the black beans with their liquid and bay leaves, and bring to a simmer.
Cover and simmer gently for 40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick and richly flavored.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve hot over rice with orange slices on the side.

recipes.title: Argentinian Milanesa Beef Cutlet Sandwich
recipes.ingredients:
3 thin beef cutlets
Salt and pepper to taste
1/2 cup flour
2 eggs, beaten
1 cup breadcrumbs
Oil, for frying
3 crusty rolls, split
Sliced tomato and lettuce
Mayonnaise
recipes.instructions:
Season the cutlets with salt and pepper.
Dredge each cutlet in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs, pressing to coat evenly.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and fry the cutlets until golden and cooked through, about 3 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels.
Spread mayonnaise on the rolls and layer with a cutlet, tomato, and lettuce.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Argentinian Choripán Sausage Sandwich
recipes.ingredients:
3 chorizo sausages
3 crusty rolls, split
1/2 cup chimichurri sauce (parsley, garlic, oregano, vinegar, olive oil)
1 tomato, diced
recipes.instructions:
Grill or pan-sear the chorizo sausages over medium heat until browned and cooked through, about 12 minutes, turning occasionally.
Split each sausage lengthwise if desired for more surface area.
Toast the rolls lightly on the grill or in a dry skillet.
Spoon chimichurri generously into each roll.
Add the sausage and top with diced tomato.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Chilean Pastel de Choclo Corn and Beef Bake
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1 onion, chopped
2 tbsp oil
1 tsp paprika
Salt and pepper to taste
1/4 cup raisins
2 hard-boiled eggs, sliced
5 cups fresh or frozen corn kernels
1 cup milk
2 tbsp butter
1 tbsp sugar
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 375 F.
Heat oil in a skillet and cook onion until soft, then add ground beef, paprika, salt, and pepper, and cook until browned.
Stir in raisins and spoon the mixture into a baking dish; arrange sliced egg over the top.
Blend the corn kernels with milk, butter, and sugar until it forms a thick, slightly chunky puree; season with salt.
Spread the corn puree evenly over the meat layer.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes until the top is set and lightly golden.

recipes.title: Colombian Bandeja Paisa-Style Beef and Bean Plate
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1 onion, chopped, divided
2 cloves garlic, minced
2 tomatoes, chopped
2 cans (15 oz each) red beans, drained
Salt and pepper to taste
3 eggs, fried
2 ripe plantains, sliced and fried
3 cups cooked rice
Sliced avocado
recipes.instructions:
Cook half the onion and garlic in a skillet until soft, then add ground beef and cook until browned, seasoning with salt and pepper.
In a separate pot, simmer the beans with remaining onion, tomatoes, and a splash of water for 20 minutes until saucy.
Fry the plantain slices in a little oil until golden on both sides.
Fry the eggs in the same pan.
Plate rice, seasoned beef, and beans together.
Top with a fried egg, fried plantain, and sliced avocado.

recipes.title: Cuban Ropa Vieja Shredded Beef
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs flank steak
4 cups beef broth
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, sliced
2 celery stalks, sliced
1 carrot, sliced
4 cloves garlic, minced
1 can (14 oz) crushed tomatoes
1 tsp dried oregano
1 bay leaf
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Simmer the flank steak in beef broth until fork-tender, about 1 1/2 hours; remove and shred with two forks, reserving the broth.
Heat oil in a pot and sauté onion, celery, carrot, and garlic until softened, about 8 minutes.
Stir in crushed tomatoes, oregano, and bay leaf, and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the shredded beef and a splash of the reserved broth, and simmer 20 minutes until well combined and tender.
Season with salt.
Serve hot with rice.

recipes.title: Puerto Rican Mofongo with Garlic Pork
recipes.ingredients:
3 green plantains, peeled and cut into chunks
Oil, for frying
6 cloves garlic, minced
1/2 tsp salt
1/2 lb pork shoulder, cubed and cooked until crisp
2 tbsp olive oil
Chicken broth, as needed
recipes.instructions:
Fry the plantain chunks in oil until golden and tender, about 8 minutes; drain.
Mash the fried plantains with garlic, salt, and olive oil in a mortar or bowl until well combined but still slightly chunky.
Fold in the cooked crispy pork.
Shape into mounds using a bowl or cup as a mold.
Drizzle with a little broth to moisten if needed.
Serve warm as a side or main.

recipes.title: Dominican Mangu Mashed Plantains with Eggs
recipes.ingredients:
3 green plantains, peeled and cut into chunks
2 tbsp butter
1/2 cup warm water or milk
Salt to taste
1 red onion, thinly sliced
2 tbsp vinegar
2 tbsp oil
5 eggs
recipes.instructions:
Boil the plantain chunks in salted water until very tender, about 20 minutes.
Mash the plantains with butter and warm water or milk until smooth, seasoning with salt.
Meanwhile, sauté the onion in oil until soft, then stir in vinegar and cook 1 minute; set aside as a topping.
Scramble or fry the eggs to your preference.
Mound the mashed plantain onto plates and top with the pickled onion.
Serve with the eggs alongside.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Crispy Turmeric Crepe (Banh Xeo)
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup rice flour
1/4 cup cornstarch
1/2 tsp turmeric
1 1/4 cups coconut milk
1/2 cup water
2 scallions, sliced
1/2 lb pork belly or chicken, thinly sliced
1 cup bean sprouts
Oil, for the pan
Lettuce leaves, mint, and dipping sauce (soy sauce, lime, chili), for serving
recipes.instructions:
Whisk rice flour, cornstarch, turmeric, coconut milk, water, and scallions into a thin batter; let rest 20 minutes.
Cook the pork or chicken in a hot skillet with a little oil until browned and cooked through; push to one side of the pan.
Pour a thin layer of batter into the pan, swirling to coat, and scatter bean sprouts over half.
Cover and cook until the edges are crisp and lacy, about 4 minutes, then fold in half like an omelet.
Slide onto a plate and repeat with remaining batter.
Serve wrapped in lettuce with mint and dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Korean Spicy Pork Bulgogi (Dweji Bulgogi)
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs thinly sliced pork shoulder
3 tbsp gochujang
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp sesame oil
4 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp ginger, minced
1 onion, sliced
2 scallions, sliced
Toasted sesame seeds, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Whisk gochujang, soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger into a marinade.
Toss the pork and onion with the marinade and let sit at least 30 minutes.
Heat a large skillet or grill pan over high heat and cook the pork mixture until caramelized and cooked through, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Stir in scallions during the last minute.
Garnish with sesame seeds.
Serve hot with rice and lettuce leaves for wrapping.

recipes.title: Korean Sundubu-Style Soft Tofu Stew
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp sesame oil
1 tbsp gochugaru (Korean chili flakes)
1 onion, chopped
3 cloves garlic, minced
2 cups mushrooms, sliced
3 cups vegetable broth
2 packages (12 oz each) soft tofu
2 tbsp soy sauce
2 eggs
Sliced scallions, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Heat sesame oil in a pot and stir in gochugaru, onion, and garlic, cooking until fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Add mushrooms and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Pour in broth and bring to a simmer.
Gently spoon in the soft tofu in large chunks and add soy sauce; simmer 8 minutes.
Crack the eggs directly into the simmering stew and cook until just set, about 2 minutes.
Garnish with scallions and serve hot with rice.

recipes.title: Japanese Oyakodon Chicken and Egg Rice Bowl
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb boneless chicken thighs, sliced
1 onion, thinly sliced
1 cup dashi or chicken broth
3 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp mirin
1 tbsp sugar
4 eggs, lightly beaten
3 cups cooked rice
Sliced scallions, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Simmer broth, soy sauce, mirin, and sugar in a skillet.
Add onion and chicken and simmer until the chicken is cooked through, about 8 minutes.
Pour the beaten eggs evenly over the top and cover, cooking until just set but still slightly runny, about 2 minutes.
Spoon the chicken and egg mixture over bowls of rice.
Garnish with scallions.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Japanese Gyudon Beef Rice Bowl
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb thinly sliced beef
1 onion, thinly sliced
1 cup dashi or beef broth
1/4 cup soy sauce
2 tbsp mirin
2 tbsp sugar
3 cups cooked rice
Pickled ginger, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Combine broth, soy sauce, mirin, and sugar in a skillet and bring to a simmer.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the beef slices and simmer until just cooked through, about 5 minutes, skimming any foam.
Let the mixture sit off heat for a few minutes to absorb the sauce.
Spoon the beef, onion, and sauce over bowls of rice.
Serve with pickled ginger.

recipes.title: Japanese Miso-Glazed Roasted Vegetables with Rice
recipes.ingredients:
2 zucchini, sliced into rounds
1 eggplant, cubed
8 oz mushrooms, halved
3 tbsp white miso
2 tbsp mirin
1 tbsp sugar
1 tbsp oil
3 cups cooked rice
Toasted sesame seeds, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 425 F.
Whisk miso, mirin, sugar, and oil into a glaze.
Toss the zucchini, eggplant, and mushrooms with the glaze on a baking sheet.
Roast 20 to 25 minutes, turning once, until tender and caramelized.
Serve the vegetables over rice.
Garnish with sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Chinese Mapo Tofu
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb soft or firm tofu, cubed
1/2 lb ground pork
2 tbsp oil
2 tbsp chili bean paste (doubanjiang)
1 tbsp fermented black beans, rinsed
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp ginger, minced
1 cup chicken broth
1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
Sliced scallions and chili oil, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a wok and brown the ground pork, breaking it up, about 5 minutes.
Stir in chili bean paste, black beans, garlic, and ginger, and cook until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add broth and bring to a simmer.
Gently slide in the tofu cubes and simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook until the sauce thickens.
Garnish with scallions and a drizzle of chili oil, and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Kung Pao Chicken
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs boneless chicken thighs, cubed
2 tbsp soy sauce, divided
1 tbsp cornstarch
3 tbsp oil
6 dried red chilies
1 tsp Sichuan peppercorns (optional)
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp ginger, minced
3 scallions, cut into pieces
1/3 cup roasted peanuts
2 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp sugar
recipes.instructions:
Toss chicken with 1 tbsp soy sauce and cornstarch and let sit 10 minutes.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the chicken until browned and cooked through; remove and set aside.
Add dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns to the wok and toast briefly, then add garlic and ginger.
Return the chicken to the wok along with scallions, peanuts, remaining soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar.
Toss everything together over high heat until well coated and glossy, about 2 minutes.
Serve hot with rice.

recipes.title: Chinese Char Siu-Style Roasted Pork
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs pork shoulder or tenderloin, cut into strips
3 tbsp hoisin sauce
2 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp honey, divided
1 tbsp Shaoxing wine or dry sherry
1 tsp five-spice powder
3 cloves garlic, minced
Steamed rice and scallions, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Whisk hoisin, soy sauce, half the honey, wine, five-spice, and garlic into a marinade.
Coat the pork strips in the marinade and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the oven to 400 F and place the pork on a rack over a foil-lined pan.
Roast 25 to 30 minutes, basting with marinade halfway through, until caramelized and cooked through.
Brush with remaining honey during the last 5 minutes for a glossy finish.
Slice and serve over rice with scallions.

recipes.title: Chinese Dan Dan Noodles with Pork
recipes.ingredients:
10 oz wheat noodles
1/2 lb ground pork
2 tbsp oil
2 tbsp chili oil
2 tbsp sesame paste or peanut butter
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp rice vinegar
3 cloves garlic, minced
2 scallions, sliced
1/4 cup chopped peanuts
recipes.instructions:
Cook the noodles according to package directions; drain and set aside.
Heat oil in a skillet and brown the ground pork until crisp in spots, about 6 minutes.
Whisk chili oil, sesame paste, soy sauce, vinegar, and garlic in the bottom of serving bowls.
Divide noodles among the bowls and toss with the sauce.
Top with the browned pork, scallions, and chopped peanuts.
Serve hot, tossing well before eating.

recipes.title: Taiwanese Beef Noodle Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs beef shank, cubed
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, sliced
4 cloves garlic
1 piece ginger, sliced
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp doubanjiang (chili bean paste)
2 star anise
1 cinnamon stick
6 cups beef broth
10 oz wheat noodles
Baby bok choy and sliced scallions, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a large pot and brown the beef shank on all sides, about 8 minutes.
Add onion, garlic, and ginger and cook until fragrant.
Stir in soy sauce, doubanjiang, star anise, and cinnamon, then pour in the broth.
Simmer, partially covered, until the beef is fork-tender, about 1 1/2 hours.
Cook the noodles separately and blanch the bok choy in the same pot.
Divide noodles and bok choy among bowls, ladle over the beef and broth, and top with scallions.

recipes.title: Thai Green Curry with Chicken
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs boneless chicken thighs, sliced
3 tbsp green curry paste
1 can (14 oz) coconut milk
1 cup chicken broth
1 eggplant, cubed
1 zucchini, sliced
1/4 cup Thai basil leaves
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar
Jasmine rice, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Heat a large pot over medium heat and fry the curry paste in a couple tablespoons of the coconut milk until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add the chicken and stir to coat, cooking until lightly browned.
Pour in the remaining coconut milk and broth, then add eggplant and zucchini.
Simmer until the chicken and vegetables are tender, about 15 minutes.
Stir in soy sauce, brown sugar, and Thai basil.
Serve hot over jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Panang Curry with Beef
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs beef stew meat, cubed
3 tbsp panang curry paste
2 cans (14 oz each) coconut milk
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp peanut butter
1/4 cup Thai basil leaves
1 red chili, sliced
Jasmine rice, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Fry the curry paste in a couple tablespoons of coconut milk in a pot until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add the beef and stir to coat.
Pour in remaining coconut milk and simmer, covered, until the beef is tender, about 25 minutes.
Stir in soy sauce, brown sugar, and peanut butter until the sauce is thick and glossy.
Stir in Thai basil and sliced chili.
Serve hot over jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapow)
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground chicken
2 tbsp oil
4 cloves garlic, minced
2 red chilies, minced
1 onion, sliced
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp hoisin sauce
1 tsp sugar
1 cup Thai basil leaves
3 eggs
Jasmine rice, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry garlic and chilies until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add ground chicken and onion, breaking up the meat, and cook until browned, about 6 minutes.
Stir in soy sauce, hoisin, and sugar, then fold in the basil leaves until wilted.
In a separate pan, fry the eggs in remaining oil until the whites are crisp and the yolks are still runny.
Serve the basil chicken over jasmine rice topped with a fried egg.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Lemongrass Grilled Pork (Thit Nuong)
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs pork shoulder, thinly sliced
2 stalks lemongrass, minced
4 cloves garlic, minced
2 tbsp brown sugar
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp oil
Rice vermicelli, lettuce, cucumber, and mint, for serving
Soy-lime dipping sauce
recipes.instructions:
Blend lemongrass, garlic, brown sugar, soy sauce, and oil into a marinade.
Toss the pork slices with the marinade and refrigerate at least 1 hour.
Grill or pan-sear the pork over high heat until charred at the edges and cooked through, about 3 minutes per side.
Cook the rice vermicelli according to package directions.
Arrange vermicelli, lettuce, cucumber, and mint in bowls and top with the grilled pork.
Serve with soy-lime dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Filipino Kare-Kare-Style Beef and Vegetable Stew
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs beef stew meat, cubed
4 cups beef broth
1/2 cup natural peanut butter
2 tbsp rice, toasted and ground
1 onion, chopped
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 eggplant, sliced
2 cups green beans, trimmed
1 bunch bok choy
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Simmer the beef in broth until very tender, about 1 hour; reserve the broth.
In a pot, sauté onion and garlic until soft, then whisk in the peanut butter and toasted ground rice with about 2 cups of the reserved broth until smooth and thickened.
Add the cooked beef back in and simmer 10 minutes.
Add eggplant and green beans and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
Stir in bok choy just until wilted.
Season with salt and serve hot with rice.

recipes.title: Filipino Bicol Express (Pork in Coconut Chili Sauce)
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs pork shoulder, cubed
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, chopped
4 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp ginger, minced
3 red chilies, sliced
2 cans (14 oz each) coconut milk
Salt to taste
Steamed rice, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and brown the pork on all sides, about 8 minutes.
Add onion, garlic, and ginger, and cook until softened.
Stir in chilies and cook 1 minute.
Pour in coconut milk and bring to a simmer, then cover and cook until the pork is tender and the sauce has thickened, about 25 minutes.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve hot over steamed rice.

recipes.title: Indonesian Ayam Bakar (Grilled Spiced Chicken)
recipes.ingredients:
2 lbs bone-in chicken pieces
4 cloves garlic
1 shallot
1 tsp ginger
1 tsp ground coriander
2 tbsp sweet soy sauce (kecap manis)
1 tbsp tamarind paste
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp oil
Steamed rice, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Blend garlic, shallot, ginger, coriander, sweet soy sauce, tamarind paste, and brown sugar into a marinade paste.
Rub the paste all over the chicken and marinate at least 1 hour.
Simmer the chicken in a pot with a splash of water and the oil until mostly cooked through, about 15 minutes.
Finish the chicken on a hot grill or under the broiler, basting with the pan sauce, until charred and caramelized, about 10 minutes.
Let rest briefly before serving.
Serve hot with steamed rice.

recipes.title: Indonesian Sayur Lodeh (Vegetable Coconut Curry)
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, sliced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp ground coriander
1 red chili, sliced
1 can (14 oz) coconut milk
1 cup vegetable broth
1 eggplant, cubed
2 cups long beans or green beans, cut into pieces
2 cups cabbage, shredded
1 block firm tofu, cubed
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and sauté onion, garlic, coriander, and chili until fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and broth and bring to a simmer.
Add eggplant and green beans and cook until nearly tender, about 10 minutes.
Stir in cabbage and tofu and simmer until the cabbage is tender, about 8 minutes.
Season with salt.
Serve hot over rice.

recipes.title: Malaysian Nasi Lemak Plate
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups jasmine rice, rinsed
1 can (14 oz) coconut milk
1 cup water
1 pandan leaf or 1/2 tsp vanilla extract
Salt to taste
1.5 lbs bone-in chicken pieces
1 tbsp curry powder
1 onion, chopped
3 tomatoes, chopped
2 red chilies, chopped
1/4 cup roasted peanuts
1 cucumber, sliced
3 eggs, hard-boiled
recipes.instructions:
Cook the rice with coconut milk, water, pandan leaf, and a pinch of salt in a rice cooker or covered pot until tender.
Toss the chicken with curry powder and sear in a hot pan until browned, then simmer with a splash of water until cooked through.
Blend onion, tomatoes, and chilies, then simmer in a little oil until thickened into a sambal-style sauce; season with salt.
Toast the peanuts in a dry pan until golden.
Plate the coconut rice with the curried chicken, sambal sauce, sliced cucumber, hard-boiled egg, and toasted peanuts.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Indian Chettinad Chicken Curry
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs bone-in chicken pieces
3 tbsp oil
1 onion, chopped
10 curry leaves
1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste
2 tomatoes, chopped
1 tbsp ground coriander
1 tsp black peppercorns, cracked
1/2 tsp turmeric
1 cup coconut milk
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and sauté onion and curry leaves until golden, about 8 minutes.
Stir in ginger-garlic paste and cook 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, coriander, pepper, and turmeric, and cook until the tomatoes break down, about 8 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook until lightly browned on all sides.
Pour in coconut milk, cover, and simmer until the chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes.
Season with salt and serve hot with rice.

recipes.title: Indian Goan-Style Coconut Vegetable Curry
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp oil
1 tsp mustard seeds
10 curry leaves
1 onion, chopped
1 tbsp ginger, minced
1 tsp ground coriander
1/2 tsp turmeric
1 tbsp tamarind paste
1 can (14 oz) coconut milk
2 cups mixed vegetables (carrot, green beans, cauliflower)
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and pop the mustard seeds, then add curry leaves and onion, cooking until soft.
Stir in ginger, coriander, and turmeric, cooking 1 minute.
Add tamarind paste and coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook until tender, about 15 minutes.
Season with salt.
Serve hot with rice.

recipes.title: Indian Baingan Bharta (Smoky Eggplant Mash)
recipes.ingredients:
2 large eggplants
3 tbsp oil
1 tsp mustard seeds
1 onion, finely chopped
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp ginger, minced
2 tomatoes, chopped
1/2 tsp turmeric
1 green chili, minced
Salt to taste
Chopped cilantro, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Roast the whole eggplants over an open flame or under the broiler until the skin blisters and the flesh is soft, about 15 to 20 minutes.
Let cool slightly, then peel and mash the flesh.
Heat oil in a pan and pop the mustard seeds, then sauté onion, garlic, and ginger until golden.
Add tomatoes, turmeric, and chili, and cook until the tomatoes break down, about 8 minutes.
Stir in the mashed eggplant and simmer 8 minutes, seasoning with salt.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with flatbread.

recipes.title: Indian Kolhapuri Chicken Curry
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs bone-in chicken pieces
3 tbsp oil
1 onion, chopped, divided
