1/4 cup dried coconut, toasted
1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste
2 tomatoes, chopped
1 tbsp ground coriander
1 tbsp paprika
1/2 tsp turmeric
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Toast the dried coconut with half the onion in a dry pan until golden, then blend into a paste with a splash of water.
Heat oil in a pot and sauté remaining onion until golden, then add ginger-garlic paste and cook 1 minute.
Stir in tomatoes, coriander, paprika, and turmeric, cooking until thickened, about 8 minutes.
Stir in the coconut-onion paste, then add the chicken and coat well.
Add a cup of water, cover, and simmer until the chicken is tender, about 20 minutes.
Season with salt and serve hot with rice.

recipes.title: Pakistani Beef Nihari-Style Stew
recipes.ingredients:
2 lbs beef shank, cubed
1/4 cup oil
1 onion, sliced
1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste
1 tbsp ground coriander
1 tbsp fennel seeds, ground
1 tsp paprika
1/2 tsp cinnamon
1/4 cup flour
6 cups beef broth
Julienned ginger and chopped cilantro, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a heavy pot and brown the beef on all sides, about 10 minutes.
Add onion and cook until softened, then stir in ginger-garlic paste, coriander, fennel, paprika, and cinnamon, cooking 2 minutes.
Whisk the flour with a little broth to make a smooth slurry, then stir into the pot along with remaining broth.
Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook low and slow until the beef is falling-apart tender, about 2 hours, stirring occasionally.
Skim any excess fat from the surface.
Garnish with julienned ginger and cilantro, and serve with flatbread.

recipes.title: Afghan Kabuli Pulao with Beef
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs beef stew meat, cubed
1/4 cup oil
2 onions, sliced
2 cups beef broth
2 cups basmati rice, rinsed
2 carrots, julienned
1/3 cup raisins
1 tsp ground cardamom
1/2 tsp cinnamon
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a heavy pot and brown the beef with onions until deeply caramelized, about 15 minutes.
Add broth, cover, and simmer until the beef is tender, about 45 minutes; remove beef and reserve the broth.
Sauté carrots and raisins in a little oil until the carrots soften and the raisins plump, about 5 minutes; set aside.
Cook the rice in the reserved beef broth with cardamom, cinnamon, and salt until tender.
Gently fold the beef back into the rice.
Top with the sautéed carrots and raisins before serving.

recipes.title: Persian Ghormeh Sabzi-Style Herb Stew with Beef
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs beef stew meat, cubed
3 tbsp oil, divided
1 onion, chopped
1/2 tsp turmeric
2 cups chopped parsley
1 cup chopped cilantro
1/2 cup chopped fenugreek leaves or spinach
2 cans (15 oz each) kidney beans, drained
2 dried limes, pierced (or juice of 1 lemon)
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pot and brown the beef with the onion and turmeric, about 8 minutes.
Sauté the parsley, cilantro, and fenugreek in remaining oil in a separate pan until deep green and fragrant, about 10 minutes.
Add the sautéed herbs to the beef along with kidney beans, dried limes, and enough water to cover.
Cover and simmer on low until the beef is very tender, about 1 hour, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve hot over rice.

recipes.title: Persian Fesenjan-Style Chicken in Walnut Pomegranate Sauce
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs bone-in chicken thighs
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, chopped
2 cups ground walnuts
1 1/2 cups chicken broth
1/3 cup pomegranate molasses
2 tbsp sugar
Salt and pepper to taste
Pomegranate seeds, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and brown the chicken on all sides, about 8 minutes; set aside.
Sauté the onion in the same pot until soft.
Toast the ground walnuts in a dry skillet until fragrant, then stir into the pot with the broth.
Return the chicken to the pot, add pomegranate molasses and sugar, and simmer, partially covered, until the chicken is tender and the sauce has thickened, about 35 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.
Garnish with pomegranate seeds and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Turkish Iskender-Style Beef over Pita
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs thinly sliced beef
2 tbsp yogurt
2 tbsp oil, divided
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp paprika
2 pita breads, torn into pieces
1 can (14 oz) crushed tomatoes
1 tbsp butter
1 cup plain yogurt
Chopped parsley, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Marinate the beef in yogurt, 1 tbsp oil, garlic, and paprika for at least 20 minutes.
Simmer the crushed tomatoes with a pinch of salt for 10 minutes to make a quick sauce.
Heat remaining oil in a hot skillet and sear the beef until browned and just cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Toast the torn pita pieces briefly in the oven or a dry skillet and arrange on plates.
Top the pita with the seared beef and warm tomato sauce.
Melt butter and drizzle over the top, then serve with a dollop of yogurt and a sprinkle of parsley.

recipes.title: Turkish Karniyarik (Stuffed Eggplant with Beef)
recipes.ingredients:
3 medium eggplants, halved lengthwise
Oil, for frying
1 lb ground beef
1 onion, chopped
2 cloves garlic, minced
2 tomatoes, chopped, divided
1 tbsp tomato paste
Salt and pepper to taste
Chopped parsley, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 375 F.
Scoop out some of the eggplant flesh to create a cavity, then lightly fry the eggplant halves in oil until softened, about 5 minutes per side.
Cook ground beef with onion and garlic until browned, then stir in half the chopped tomatoes and tomato paste, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Arrange the eggplant halves in a baking dish and fill each with the beef mixture.
Top with remaining chopped tomato and a splash of water in the dish.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes until the eggplant is tender, then garnish with parsley before serving.

recipes.title: Greek Youvetsi Beef and Orzo Bake
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs beef stew meat, cubed
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, chopped
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 can (14 oz) crushed tomatoes
2 cups beef broth
1 cinnamon stick
1 cup orzo pasta
Grated Parmesan or feta, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 350 F.
Heat olive oil in an ovenproof pot and brown the beef on all sides, about 8 minutes.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened, then stir in crushed tomatoes, broth, and cinnamon stick.
Cover and braise in the oven until the beef is tender, about 1 hour.
Stir in the orzo and return to the oven, uncovered, until the orzo is tender, about 20 minutes, adding a splash more broth if needed.
Remove the cinnamon stick and serve topped with grated cheese.

recipes.title: Greek Fasolada Bean Soup
recipes.ingredients:
3 cans (15 oz each) white beans, drained
1/4 cup olive oil
1 onion, chopped
2 carrots, diced
2 celery stalks, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 can (14 oz) crushed tomatoes
4 cups vegetable broth
1 bay leaf
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Heat olive oil in a pot and sauté onion, carrots, and celery until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Stir in crushed tomatoes, broth, bay leaf, and beans.
Simmer, partially covered, for 25 to 30 minutes until the vegetables are tender and the soup has thickened slightly.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve hot with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Cypriot Beef Stifado
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs beef stew meat, cubed
2 tbsp olive oil
1 lb pearl onions, peeled
3 cloves garlic, minced
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 can (14 oz) crushed tomatoes
1 cinnamon stick
2 bay leaves
1 cup beef broth
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Heat olive oil in a heavy pot and brown the beef on all sides, about 8 minutes.
Add pearl onions and garlic and cook until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Stir in vinegar, crushed tomatoes, cinnamon stick, bay leaves, and broth.
Cover and simmer on low until the beef is very tender, about 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper.
Remove the cinnamon stick and bay leaves before serving with rice or bread.

recipes.title: Balkan Cevapi Grilled Sausages with Flatbread
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs ground beef
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp baking soda
1/2 tsp paprika
Salt and pepper to taste
3 flatbreads
1 onion, chopped
1/2 cup sour cream
recipes.instructions:
Mix ground beef with garlic, baking soda, paprika, salt, and pepper until well combined and slightly sticky.
Shape into small finger-length sausages and chill at least 1 hour to firm up.
Grill or pan-sear the sausages over medium-high heat until charred and cooked through, about 8 to 10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Warm the flatbreads on the grill or in a dry skillet.
Serve the sausages wrapped in flatbread with chopped onion and a dollop of sour cream.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Serbian-Style Stuffed Cabbage Rolls with Beef and Rice
recipes.ingredients:
1 head cabbage
1 lb ground beef
1/2 cup cooked rice
1 onion, finely chopped
1 egg
Salt and pepper to taste
1 tsp paprika
2 cups crushed tomatoes
2 cups beef broth
1 tbsp oil
recipes.instructions:
Core the cabbage and blanch it whole in boiling water until the leaves soften enough to peel off, about 5 minutes; separate the leaves.
Mix ground beef, rice, onion, egg, salt, pepper, and paprika for the filling.
Spoon filling onto each cabbage leaf and roll up, tucking in the sides.
Arrange the rolls seam-side down in a pot, pour crushed tomatoes and broth over the top, and drizzle with oil.
Cover and simmer gently until the rolls are cooked through and tender, about 1 1/4 hours.
Serve warm with the sauce spooned over the top.

recipes.title: Polish Pierogi with Potato and Cheese
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups flour
1 egg
1/2 cup sour cream
1/4 cup warm water
1/2 tsp salt
2 potatoes, boiled and mashed
1 cup shredded cheddar
1 onion, chopped
3 tbsp butter
recipes.instructions:
Mix flour, egg, sour cream, warm water, and salt into a smooth dough; let rest 20 minutes.
Combine the mashed potato with cheddar for the filling.
Roll the dough thin and cut into rounds; place a spoonful of filling in the center of each and fold into a half-moon, pinching to seal.
Boil the pierogi in salted water until they float, about 4 minutes, then drain.
Sauté onion in butter until golden.
Pan-fry the boiled pierogi in the buttery onions until lightly browned, then serve warm.

recipes.title: Hungarian Beef Goulash
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs beef chuck, cubed
2 tbsp oil
2 onions, chopped
3 cloves garlic, minced
3 tbsp paprika
1 tbsp tomato paste
2 carrots, sliced
2 potatoes, cubed
4 cups beef broth
1 bay leaf
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a heavy pot and brown the beef on all sides, about 8 minutes.
Add onions and garlic and cook until softened, about 8 minutes.
Remove from heat briefly and stir in paprika and tomato paste to avoid scorching, then return to heat.
Add carrots, potatoes, broth, and bay leaf, and bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook until the beef is very tender, about 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Czech Beef Svíčková-Style with Creamy Sauce
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs beef chuck roast
2 tbsp oil
2 carrots, chopped
1 parsnip, chopped
1 onion, chopped
2 tbsp tomato paste
2 bay leaves
5 whole allspice berries
2 cups beef broth
1/2 cup sour cream
2 tbsp flour
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a heavy pot and brown the beef on all sides, about 10 minutes; remove.
Sauté carrots, parsnip, and onion until softened, about 10 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste, bay leaves, and allspice, then return the beef to the pot and add broth.
Cover and braise until the beef is fork-tender, about 1 1/2 hours, turning occasionally.
Remove the beef and blend the vegetables and cooking liquid with sour cream and flour until smooth, then simmer until thickened.
Slice the beef, ladle the creamy sauce over the top, and serve with bread dumplings or boiled potatoes.

recipes.title: Romanian Mămăligă with Cheese and Sour Cream
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup coarse cornmeal
3 cups water
1 tsp salt
1 tbsp butter
1 cup crumbled feta or farmer's cheese
1/2 cup sour cream
recipes.instructions:
Bring water and salt to a boil in a heavy pot.
Whisk in the cornmeal gradually to avoid lumps.
Reduce heat to low and cook, stirring frequently, until thick and smooth, about 20 minutes.
Stir in the butter until melted.
Spoon the polenta into bowls and top with crumbled cheese and a dollop of sour cream.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Ukrainian Borscht with Beef
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb beef stew meat, cubed
6 cups beef broth
3 beets, peeled and grated
2 carrots, grated
1 onion, chopped
2 potatoes, cubed
2 cups shredded cabbage
2 tbsp tomato paste
1 tbsp vinegar
Sour cream and dill, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Simmer the beef in broth until tender, about 40 minutes, skimming any foam.
Add potatoes and cabbage and simmer 10 minutes.
In a separate pan, sauté onion and carrots until soft, then stir in grated beets and tomato paste, cooking 5 minutes.
Add the beet mixture to the soup along with vinegar and simmer 15 minutes more until the vegetables are tender.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve hot topped with sour cream and fresh dill.

recipes.title: Russian Solyanka-Style Meat and Vegetable Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1/2 lb smoked sausage, sliced
1/2 lb beef stew meat, cubed
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, chopped
2 dill pickles, diced, plus 1/4 cup pickle brine
2 tbsp tomato paste
5 cups beef broth
2 potatoes, cubed
Lemon slices and dill, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and brown the sausage and beef, about 8 minutes.
Add onion and cook until softened.
Stir in tomato paste and cook 2 minutes, then add broth, potatoes, diced pickles, and pickle brine.
Simmer until the beef and potatoes are tender, about 30 minutes.
Adjust seasoning with more brine or salt as needed.
Serve hot with a lemon slice and fresh dill.

recipes.title: Georgian Chicken Chakhokhbili Stew
recipes.ingredients:
2 lbs bone-in chicken pieces
2 tbsp oil
2 onions, sliced
4 cloves garlic, minced
4 tomatoes, chopped
1/4 cup chopped cilantro
1 tsp dried marjoram or oregano
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and brown the chicken pieces on all sides, about 10 minutes; set aside.
Sauté the onions in the same pot until deep golden, about 10 minutes.
Add garlic and tomatoes and cook until the tomatoes break down, about 10 minutes.
Return the chicken to the pot, cover, and simmer until cooked through and tender, about 25 minutes.
Stir in cilantro and marjoram during the last few minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Armenian Beef and Rice Stuffed Grape Leaves (Dolma)
recipes.ingredients:
1 jar (16 oz) grape leaves, rinsed
1 lb ground beef
1/2 cup rice, rinsed
1 onion, finely chopped
1/4 cup chopped parsley
1/4 cup chopped mint
Salt and pepper to taste
Juice of 2 lemons
2 cups water or broth
recipes.instructions:
Mix ground beef, rice, onion, parsley, mint, salt, and pepper for the filling.
Lay a grape leaf flat, place a small spoonful of filling near the stem end, and roll up tightly, tucking in the sides.
Line the bottom of a pot with a few extra grape leaves, then arrange the rolls snugly in layers.
Pour lemon juice and water or broth over the rolls, and place a small plate on top to weigh them down.
Cover and simmer gently until the rice is tender, about 40 minutes.
Serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: German Rouladen Beef Rolls
recipes.ingredients:
6 thin slices beef top round
2 tbsp mustard
3 slices bacon, chopped
1 onion, thinly sliced
2 dill pickles, sliced into strips
2 tbsp oil
2 cups beef broth
2 tbsp flour
recipes.instructions:
Spread mustard over each beef slice and top with bacon, onion, and pickle strips.
Roll up each slice tightly and secure with toothpicks or kitchen twine.
Heat oil in a heavy pot and brown the rolls on all sides, about 6 minutes.
Add beef broth, cover, and simmer until very tender, about 1 hour 15 minutes.
Remove the rolls and whisk flour into the pan juices, simmering until thickened into a gravy.
Slice the rolls if desired and serve with the gravy and boiled potatoes.

recipes.title: German Jägerschnitzel Pork Cutlet with Mushroom Sauce
recipes.ingredients:
3 thin pork cutlets
Salt and pepper to taste
1/2 cup flour
1 egg, beaten
1 cup breadcrumbs
Oil, for frying
8 oz mushrooms, sliced
1 onion, chopped
1 cup beef broth
1/2 cup sour cream
recipes.instructions:
Season the cutlets with salt and pepper, then dredge in flour, egg, and breadcrumbs.
Fry the cutlets in oil over medium heat until golden and cooked through, about 3 minutes per side; keep warm.
In the same pan, sauté onion and mushrooms until browned, about 8 minutes.
Add broth and simmer until slightly reduced.
Stir in sour cream and simmer gently until thickened, without boiling.
Spoon the mushroom sauce over the cutlets and serve with spaetzle or potatoes.

recipes.title: Austrian Wiener Schnitzel
recipes.ingredients:
3 thin pork or veal cutlets, pounded thin
Salt to taste
1/2 cup flour
2 eggs, beaten
1 cup breadcrumbs
Oil and butter, for frying
Lemon wedges, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Season the cutlets with salt.
Dredge each cutlet in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs, pressing gently so the crumbs adhere loosely.
Heat a generous layer of oil and butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the cutlets until golden brown and cooked through, about 2 to 3 minutes per side, shaking the pan gently to help the crust puff.
Drain briefly on paper towels.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges and a simple potato salad.

recipes.title: Swiss Rösti with Fried Egg
recipes.ingredients:
2 lbs russet potatoes, peeled
Salt and pepper to taste
3 tbsp butter, divided
3 eggs
Chopped chives, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Parboil the potatoes whole until just barely tender, about 10 minutes, then cool and grate coarsely.
Season the grated potato with salt and pepper.
Melt half the butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat and press the potato into an even cake.
Cook until deep golden on the bottom, about 10 minutes, then flip using a plate and cook the other side with remaining butter until crisp, about 8 minutes more.
Fry the eggs separately to your liking.
Slice the rösti into wedges and top with a fried egg and chives.

recipes.title: Belgian Carbonnade Flamande Beef and Beer Stew
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs beef chuck, cubed
2 tbsp oil
2 onions, sliced
2 tbsp flour
1 1/2 cups brown ale or beer
1 cup beef broth
1 tbsp brown sugar
2 tbsp mustard
2 bay leaves
1 tsp dried thyme
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a heavy pot and brown the beef on all sides, about 8 minutes; set aside.
Sauté the onions in the same pot until deep golden, about 12 minutes.
Stir in flour and cook 1 minute, then whisk in the ale and broth.
Return the beef to the pot along with brown sugar, mustard, bay leaves, and thyme.
Cover and simmer gently until the beef is very tender, about 1 1/2 hours.
Remove the bay leaves and serve hot with crusty bread or fries.

recipes.title: French Cassoulet-Style White Bean and Sausage Bake
recipes.ingredients:
3 cans (15 oz each) white beans, drained
1/2 lb smoked sausage, sliced
1/2 lb bacon, chopped
1 onion, chopped
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 can (14 oz) crushed tomatoes
2 cups chicken broth
1 bay leaf
1 tsp dried thyme
1/2 cup breadcrumbs
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 375 F.
Cook bacon in an ovenproof pot until crisp, then add sausage and brown, about 6 minutes.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened.
Stir in crushed tomatoes, broth, bay leaf, thyme, and beans.
Sprinkle breadcrumbs over the top and bake uncovered for 40 to 45 minutes until bubbling and the top is golden.
Remove the bay leaf and serve hot.

recipes.title: French Pissaladière-Style Onion Tart
recipes.ingredients:
1 sheet puff pastry, thawed
3 tbsp olive oil
4 onions, thinly sliced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp fresh thyme leaves
Salt and pepper to taste
1 egg, beaten, for brushing
recipes.instructions:
Heat olive oil in a skillet over low heat and cook the onions slowly, stirring occasionally, until deeply caramelized, about 35 minutes.
Stir in garlic and thyme during the last few minutes and season with salt and pepper.
Preheat the oven to 400 F and roll out the puff pastry onto a baking sheet.
Spread the caramelized onions evenly over the pastry, leaving a small border, and brush the border with beaten egg.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes until the pastry is puffed and golden.
Slice into pieces and serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: French-Style Basque Chicken with Tomatoes and Zucchini
recipes.ingredients:
2 lbs bone-in chicken thighs
Salt and pepper to taste
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, sliced
2 cloves garlic, minced
2 zucchini, sliced
3 tomatoes, chopped
1/2 cup chicken broth
1 tsp smoked paprika
Chopped parsley, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a large skillet and brown the chicken skin-side down until golden, about 6 minutes per side; set aside.
Sauté onion and garlic in the same pan until softened.
Add zucchini, tomatoes, broth, and smoked paprika, and simmer 5 minutes.
Return the chicken to the pan, cover, and simmer until cooked through, about 20 minutes.
Garnish with parsley and serve with rice or crusty bread.

recipes.title: Portuguese Bifana Pork Sandwich
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs thin pork cutlets
4 cloves garlic, minced
1 cup white wine or broth
1 bay leaf
1 tsp paprika
2 tbsp oil
3 crusty rolls
Mustard, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Marinate the pork in garlic, wine, bay leaf, and paprika for at least 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the pork cutlets, along with the marinade, until browned and just cooked through, about 3 minutes per side.
Remove the pork and simmer the remaining marinade until slightly reduced.
Slice the rolls and warm them briefly.
Pile the pork into the rolls and spoon a little of the reduced sauce over the top.
Serve with mustard.

recipes.title: Spanish Fabada Asturiana Bean Stew with Chorizo
recipes.ingredients:
3 cans (15 oz each) large white beans, drained
1/2 lb chorizo, sliced
1/2 lb pork belly or bacon, cubed
1 onion, chopped
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp smoked paprika
1 bay leaf
3 cups chicken broth
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Brown the chorizo and pork belly in a pot over medium heat, about 8 minutes.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened.
Stir in smoked paprika, bay leaf, broth, and beans.
Simmer, partially covered, for 40 minutes until the flavors meld and the stew thickens slightly.
Season with salt.
Serve hot with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Spanish Patatas a la Riojana (Potato and Chorizo Stew)
recipes.ingredients:
4 potatoes, cut into chunks
1/2 lb chorizo, sliced
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, chopped
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp smoked paprika
4 cups chicken broth
1 bay leaf
Chopped parsley, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Heat olive oil in a pot and brown the chorizo, about 5 minutes; set aside.
Sauté onion and garlic in the same pot until softened.
Stir in smoked paprika, then add potatoes, broth, and bay leaf.
Simmer until the potatoes are tender, about 20 minutes, breaking a few potato pieces against the side of the pot to thicken the broth.
Return the chorizo to the pot and simmer 5 minutes more.
Garnish with parsley and serve hot.

recipes.title: Italian Porchetta-Style Roasted Pork
recipes.ingredients:
2.5 lb pork loin roast
4 cloves garlic, minced
2 tbsp fresh rosemary, chopped
2 tbsp fennel seeds, crushed
Zest of 1 lemon
1/4 cup olive oil
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 375 F.
Mix garlic, rosemary, fennel seeds, lemon zest, olive oil, salt, and pepper into a paste.
Rub the paste all over the pork loin, working some into any slits cut into the meat.
Place on a roasting rack and roast until the internal temperature reaches 145 F, about 1 hour 15 minutes.
Let rest 10 minutes before slicing.
Serve with roasted potatoes or a green salad.

recipes.title: Italian Bolognese-Style Baked Rigatoni
recipes.ingredients:
12 oz rigatoni
1 lb ground beef
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, chopped
2 carrots, finely diced
2 celery stalks, finely diced
1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes
1/2 cup milk
1 cup shredded mozzarella
1/2 cup grated Parmesan
recipes.instructions:
Heat olive oil in a pot and sauté onion, carrots, and celery until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add ground beef and cook until browned.
Stir in crushed tomatoes and simmer 25 minutes, then stir in milk and simmer 10 minutes more.
Cook the rigatoni until just shy of al dente; drain and toss with the sauce.
Transfer to a baking dish, top with mozzarella and Parmesan, and bake at 400 F for 15 to 20 minutes until bubbly and golden.
Let rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Italian Caponata (Sweet and Sour Eggplant)
recipes.ingredients:
2 eggplants, cubed
1/4 cup olive oil, divided
1 onion, chopped
2 celery stalks, chopped
2 cups crushed tomatoes
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tbsp sugar
2 tbsp raisins
2 tbsp pine nuts
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Heat half the olive oil in a large skillet and cook the eggplant until softened and lightly browned, about 10 minutes; set aside.
Heat remaining oil and sauté onion and celery until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes, vinegar, and sugar, and simmer 10 minutes.
Return the eggplant to the pan along with raisins and pine nuts, and simmer 10 minutes more until thickened.
Season with salt.
Serve warm or at room temperature with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Sicilian-Style Pasta with Eggplant (Pasta alla Norma)
recipes.ingredients:
12 oz rigatoni or penne
1 large eggplant, cubed
1/4 cup olive oil, divided
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes
1 tsp dried oregano
Salt and pepper to taste
1 cup ricotta salata or feta, crumbled
Fresh basil, torn
recipes.instructions:
Heat half the olive oil in a skillet and fry the eggplant cubes until golden and tender, about 10 minutes; set aside.
Heat remaining oil and sauté garlic until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add crushed tomatoes and oregano and simmer 15 minutes, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Stir the fried eggplant into the sauce.
Cook the pasta until al dente, then toss with the sauce.
Top with crumbled ricotta salata and torn basil before serving.

recipes.title: West African Peanut and Spinach Stew with Beef
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs beef stew meat, cubed
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, chopped
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp ginger, minced
2 tomatoes, chopped
1/2 cup natural peanut butter
3 cups beef broth
1 lb spinach, chopped
1 chili, minced (optional)
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and brown the beef on all sides, about 8 minutes.
Add onion, garlic, and ginger, and cook until softened.
Stir in tomatoes and cook until they break down, about 6 minutes.
Whisk peanut butter with broth until smooth and add to the pot, then cover and simmer until the beef is tender, about 30 minutes.
Stir in spinach and chili and cook until wilted, about 5 minutes.
Season with salt and serve hot over rice.

recipes.title: Ethiopian Doro Wat-Style Chicken Stew
recipes.ingredients:
2 lbs bone-in chicken thighs
1/4 cup oil
2 onions, finely chopped
4 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp ginger, minced
3 tbsp paprika
1/2 tsp cinnamon
1/4 tsp ground cardamom
2 tbsp tomato paste
2 cups chicken broth
3 eggs, hard-boiled
recipes.instructions:
Cook the onions in a dry pot over medium heat, stirring often, until they release their liquid and turn deep golden, about 15 minutes.
Stir in oil, garlic, and ginger, and cook 2 minutes.
Add paprika, cinnamon, and cardamom, and cook 2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in tomato paste and broth, then add the chicken and simmer, covered, until tender, about 30 minutes.
Add the peeled hard-boiled eggs during the last 10 minutes to warm through and absorb the sauce.
Season with salt and serve with flatbread or rice.

recipes.title: Ethiopian Tofu Tibs (Sautéed Tofu and Vegetables)
recipes.ingredients:
1 block firm tofu, cubed and pressed
3 tbsp oil, divided
1 onion, sliced
2 tomatoes, chopped
1 jalapeño, sliced
1 tsp paprika
1/2 tsp ground rosemary
Salt to taste
Flatbread, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Pan-fry the tofu in 2 tbsp oil until golden on all sides; set aside.
Heat remaining oil and sauté onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes, jalapeño, paprika, and rosemary, and cook until the tomatoes break down, about 8 minutes.
Return the tofu to the pan and toss to coat, cooking 3 minutes more.
Season with salt.
Serve hot with flatbread.

recipes.title: Somali-Style Beef and Rice (Bariis)
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs beef stew meat, cubed
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, chopped
3 cloves garlic, minced
2 cups basmati rice, rinsed
1 tsp ground cardamom
1/2 tsp cinnamon
1/4 tsp ground cloves
3 cups beef broth
2 tbsp raisins
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and brown the beef on all sides, about 8 minutes.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened.
Stir in cardamom, cinnamon, and cloves, and cook 1 minute.
Add broth and simmer, covered, until the beef is tender, about 25 minutes.
Stir in the rice and raisins, cover, and cook on low until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed, about 20 minutes.
Fluff with a fork before serving.

recipes.title: Sudanese-Style Beef and Okra Stew
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs beef stew meat, cubed
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, chopped
3 cloves garlic, minced
2 tomatoes, chopped
2 tbsp tomato paste
3 cups beef broth
1 lb okra, trimmed and sliced
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a pot and brown the beef on all sides, about 8 minutes.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened.
Stir in tomatoes and tomato paste and cook until thickened, about 8 minutes.
Add broth and simmer, covered, until the beef is tender, about 25 minutes.
Add okra and simmer until tender, about 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot over rice.

recipes.title: Spanish Patatas Bravas
recipes.ingredients:
4 potatoes, cubed
3 tbsp olive oil, divided
Salt to taste
1 can (14 oz) crushed tomatoes
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp smoked paprika
1/4 tsp chili flakes
1 tbsp red wine vinegar
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 425 F and toss the potatoes with 2 tbsp olive oil and salt on a baking sheet.
Roast, turning occasionally, until crisp and golden, about 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat remaining olive oil in a saucepan and sauté garlic until fragrant.
Add crushed tomatoes, smoked paprika, and chili flakes, and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in vinegar and season with salt.
Spoon the sauce over the roasted potatoes and serve warm.

recipes.title: Spanish Pan con Tomate
recipes.ingredients:
6 slices crusty bread
2 ripe tomatoes, halved
2 cloves garlic, halved
3 tbsp olive oil
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Toast the bread slices until golden and crisp.
Rub each slice with the cut side of a garlic clove.
Rub the cut side of the tomato over the bread, pressing to release the pulp and juice into the toast, discarding the skins.
Drizzle generously with olive oil.
Season with salt.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Italian Arancini Rice Balls
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups cooked risotto or short-grain rice, chilled
1/2 cup grated Parmesan
4 oz mozzarella, cut into small cubes
1/2 cup flour
2 eggs, beaten
1 cup breadcrumbs
Oil, for frying
recipes.instructions:
Mix the chilled rice with Parmesan.
Scoop a portion of rice into your palm, press a mozzarella cube into the center, and shape into a ball, sealing the cheese inside.
Roll each ball in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs.
Heat about 2 inches of oil to 350 F and fry the balls in batches until golden and crisp, about 3 to 4 minutes.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Italian Bruschetta with Tomato and Basil
recipes.ingredients:
6 slices baguette
3 tomatoes, diced
1 clove garlic, minced
1/4 cup chopped basil
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tbsp balsamic vinegar
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.instructions:
Toast the baguette slices until golden.
Combine tomatoes, garlic, basil, olive oil, and balsamic vinegar in a bowl.
Season with salt and pepper and let sit 10 minutes for the flavors to meld.
Spoon the tomato mixture generously onto the toasted bread.
Serve immediately while the bread is still crisp.

recipes.title: Italian Panzerotti Fried Dough Pockets
recipes.ingredients:
2 1/2 cups flour
1 tsp instant yeast
1 tsp salt
1 cup warm water
1 tbsp olive oil
1 cup marinara sauce
1 cup shredded mozzarella
Oil, for frying
recipes.instructions:
Mix flour, yeast, salt, warm water, and olive oil into a soft dough; knead 5 minutes and let rise 1 hour.
Divide the dough into small rounds and roll each thin.
Spoon a little marinara and mozzarella onto one half of each round, fold over, and crimp the edges to seal.
Heat about 2 inches of oil to 350 F and fry the pockets until golden and puffed, about 2 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Greek Spanakopita Bites
recipes.ingredients:
1 package phyllo dough, thawed
10 oz frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
1 cup crumbled feta
2 eggs
1 small onion, finely chopped and sautéed
1/4 cup melted butter
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 375 F.
Mix spinach, feta, eggs, and sautéed onion in a bowl.
Cut phyllo sheets into strips and brush each with melted butter.
Place a spoonful of filling at one end of a strip and fold into a triangle, flag-style, all the way up.
Brush the tops with more butter and arrange on a baking sheet.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes until golden and crisp.

recipes.title: Turkish Simit Sesame Bread Rings
recipes.ingredients:
3 cups flour
1 tsp instant yeast
1 tsp sugar
1 tsp salt
1 cup warm water
2 tbsp molasses
1 cup water, for dipping
1 cup sesame seeds
recipes.instructions:
Mix flour, yeast, sugar, salt, and warm water into a smooth dough; knead 8 minutes and let rise 1 hour.
Divide into 6 pieces, roll each into a long rope, and join the ends to form a ring.
Whisk molasses into a cup of water and dip each ring, then coat generously in sesame seeds.
Arrange on a baking sheet and let rest 15 minutes.
Bake at 425 F for 18 to 20 minutes until deep golden and crisp.
Cool slightly before serving.

recipes.title: Turkish Cheese Borek
recipes.ingredients:
1 package phyllo dough, thawed
2 cups crumbled feta
1 cup cottage cheese, drained
1 egg
Chopped parsley
1/4 cup melted butter
1 egg yolk, beaten, for brushing
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 375 F.
Mix feta, cottage cheese, egg, and parsley for the filling.
Layer sheets of phyllo in a greased baking dish, brushing every other sheet with butter.
Spread half the filling over the phyllo, add a few more buttered sheets, then the rest of the filling, and top with remaining phyllo sheets.
Brush the top with egg yolk and score into squares.
Bake 25 minutes until deep golden and crisp, then cut along the scored lines to serve.

recipes.title: Lebanese Baba Ghanoush with Pita
recipes.ingredients:
2 large eggplants
1/4 cup tahini
Juice of 1 lemon
2 cloves garlic, minced
Salt to taste
2 tbsp olive oil
Chopped parsley, for garnish
Warm pita bread, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Roast the whole eggplants under the broiler or over an open flame, turning occasionally, until the skin is charred and the flesh is soft, about 20 to 25 minutes.
Let cool slightly, then scoop out the flesh and drain off excess liquid.
Mash or blend the eggplant flesh with tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and salt until smooth.
Spoon into a bowl and drizzle with olive oil.
Garnish with parsley.
Serve with warm pita bread.

recipes.title: Indian Vegetable Samosas
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups flour
1/4 cup oil, plus more for frying
1/2 tsp salt
1/2 cup water
2 potatoes, boiled and diced
1/2 cup green beans, diced small
1 carrot, diced small
1 tsp ground coriander
1/2 tsp turmeric
1 green chili, minced
recipes.instructions:
Mix flour, oil, salt, and water into a firm dough; let rest 20 minutes.
Sauté the potatoes, green beans, carrot, coriander, turmeric, and chili in a little oil until well combined and fragrant, about 8 minutes; let cool.
Roll the dough into thin rounds, cut in half, and shape each half into a cone, sealing the seam with water.
Fill each cone with the vegetable filling and seal the top edge.
Heat about 2 inches of oil to 350 F and fry the samosas until golden and crisp, about 5 minutes.
Drain and serve warm with chutney.

recipes.title: Indian Vegetable Pakoras
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups chickpea flour
1 tsp ground coriander
1/2 tsp turmeric
1/2 tsp baking soda
Salt to taste
3/4 cup water
1 potato, thinly sliced
1 onion, thinly sliced
1 cup spinach leaves
Oil, for frying
recipes.instructions:
Whisk chickpea flour, coriander, turmeric, baking soda, salt, and water into a thick batter.
Add potato, onion, and spinach to the batter and toss to coat well.
Heat about 2 inches of oil to 350 F.
Drop spoonfuls of the vegetable-batter mixture into the oil and fry until golden and crisp, about 4 minutes, turning once.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve hot with chutney.

recipes.title: Indian Papdi Chaat
recipes.ingredients:
20 small crisp flour crackers (papdi) or tortilla chips
1 cup boiled and diced potato
1 cup cooked chickpeas
1 cup plain yogurt, whisked smooth
1/2 cup tamarind chutney
1/4 cup mint-cilantro chutney
1 tsp chaat masala or ground coriander
Chopped cilantro and diced onion, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Arrange the papdi crackers on a platter.
Top with diced potato and chickpeas.
Drizzle generously with whisked yogurt, tamarind chutney, and mint-cilantro chutney.
Sprinkle with chaat masala.
Garnish with cilantro and diced onion.
Serve immediately so the crackers stay crisp.

recipes.title: Korean Kimchi Pancake (Kimchijeon)
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup chopped kimchi, plus 2 tbsp kimchi juice
1 cup flour
1/2 cup water
1 egg
2 scallions, sliced
Oil, for the pan
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tsp sesame oil
recipes.instructions:
Whisk flour, water, egg, kimchi juice, and a pinch of salt into a batter.
Stir in the chopped kimchi and scallions.
Heat oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat and pour in the batter, spreading into a thin round.
Cook until golden and crisp on the bottom, about 4 minutes, then flip and cook the other side.
Whisk soy sauce, vinegar, and sesame oil for a dipping sauce.
Slice the pancake into wedges and serve with the dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Japanese Okonomiyaki Cabbage Pancake
recipes.ingredients:
4 cups shredded cabbage
1 cup flour
1/2 cup dashi or water
2 eggs
4 strips bacon, chopped
Oil, for the pan
1/4 cup mayonnaise
3 tbsp okonomiyaki or Worcestershire-style sauce
Bonito flakes and pickled ginger, for topping (optional)
recipes.instructions:
Whisk flour, dashi, and eggs into a smooth batter, then fold in the shredded cabbage.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat and scatter chopped bacon in the pan.
Pour the cabbage batter over the bacon, shaping into a thick round.
Cook until golden on the bottom, about 6 minutes, then flip carefully and cook the other side, about 6 minutes more.
Drizzle with sauce and mayonnaise in a crosshatch pattern.
Top with bonito flakes and pickled ginger if desired, then slice and serve.

recipes.title: Chinese Scallion Pancakes
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups flour
3/4 cup hot water
2 tbsp sesame oil, plus more for cooking
1/2 cup sliced scallions
Salt to taste
Soy dipping sauce, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Mix flour with hot water to form a dough; knead until smooth and let rest 20 minutes.
Roll the dough into a large thin rectangle, brush with sesame oil, and sprinkle with scallions and salt.
Roll the dough up into a log, then coil it into a spiral and flatten into a disk; repeat to make 3 pancakes.
Roll each disk out again to about 1/4 inch thick.
Cook each pancake in a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat until golden and crisp on both sides, about 3 minutes per side.
Cut into wedges and serve with soy dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Chinese Pork and Cabbage Potstickers
recipes.ingredients:
1/2 lb ground pork
1 cup finely chopped cabbage, squeezed dry
2 scallions, minced
1 tbsp ginger, minced
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tsp sesame oil
30 round dumpling wrappers
2 tbsp oil
1/2 cup water
recipes.instructions:
Mix ground pork, cabbage, scallions, ginger, soy sauce, and sesame oil for the filling.
Place a spoonful of filling in the center of each wrapper, moisten the edges, and fold into a pleated half-moon shape.
Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat and arrange the dumplings in a single layer.
Cook until the bottoms are golden, about 2 minutes, then add water and cover immediately to steam.
Cook until the water evaporates and the wrappers are translucent, about 6 minutes.
Serve hot with soy-vinegar dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Fresh Spring Rolls with Peanut Sauce
recipes.ingredients:
8 rice paper wrappers
4 oz rice vermicelli, cooked
1 cup shredded lettuce
1 carrot, julienned
1 cucumber, julienned
1/2 lb cooked chicken, sliced, or fried tofu
Fresh mint and cilantro
1/3 cup peanut butter
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp lime juice
Warm water, as needed
recipes.instructions:
Dip a rice paper wrapper in warm water briefly until pliable.
Layer lettuce, vermicelli, carrot, cucumber, chicken, mint, and cilantro on the lower third of the wrapper.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly like a burrito.
Repeat with remaining wrappers and filling.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, and warm water into a smooth dipping sauce.
Serve the rolls with the peanut dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Filipino Fried Lumpia Spring Rolls
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground pork
1 carrot, grated
1/2 cup finely chopped cabbage
3 scallions, minced
2 cloves garlic, minced
2 tbsp soy sauce
20 lumpia or spring roll wrappers
Oil, for frying
Sweet chili sauce, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Mix ground pork, carrot, cabbage, scallions, garlic, and soy sauce for the filling.
Place a spoonful of filling near one edge of a wrapper and roll up tightly, tucking in the sides, sealing the edge with a little water.
Repeat with remaining wrappers and filling.
Heat about 2 inches of oil to 350 F and fry the rolls in batches until golden and crisp, about 5 minutes.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve hot with sweet chili sauce.

recipes.title: Indonesian Tempeh Satay Skewers with Peanut Sauce
recipes.ingredients:
16 oz tempeh, cubed
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp oil
2 cloves garlic, minced
1/2 cup peanut butter
1 tbsp lime juice
1 tsp chili flakes
1/2 cup warm water
Wooden skewers, soaked
recipes.instructions:
Toss tempeh cubes with soy sauce, brown sugar, oil, and garlic, and let marinate 20 minutes.
Thread the tempeh onto soaked skewers.
Grill or pan-sear the skewers over medium-high heat until browned on all sides, about 8 minutes.
Whisk peanut butter, lime juice, chili flakes, and warm water into a smooth sauce.
Serve the skewers with the peanut sauce for dipping.
Garnish with extra chili flakes if desired.

recipes.title: Ethiopian Lentil Sambusas
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups flour
1/4 cup oil, plus more for frying
1/2 tsp salt
1/2 cup water
1 cup red lentils, cooked and drained
1 onion, finely chopped and sautéed
1 tsp paprika
1/2 tsp ground ginger
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Mix flour, oil, salt, and water into a firm dough; let rest 20 minutes.
Mash the cooked lentils with sautéed onion, paprika, ginger, and salt for the filling.
Roll the dough thin and cut into strips; fold each strip into a triangular pocket, adding a spoonful of filling as you fold.
Seal the edges with a little water.
Heat about 2 inches of oil to 350 F and fry the sambusas until golden and crisp, about 4 minutes.
Drain and serve warm.

recipes.title: Nigerian Puff Puff Fried Dough Balls
recipes.ingredients:
2 1/2 cups flour
1/2 cup sugar
1 tsp instant yeast
1/4 tsp nutmeg
1/2 tsp salt
1 1/4 cups warm water
Oil, for frying
recipes.instructions:
Whisk flour, sugar, yeast, nutmeg, and salt in a bowl.
Stir in warm water to form a thick, sticky batter; cover and let rise in a warm spot for 1 hour until bubbly.
Heat about 2 inches of oil to 350 F.
Scoop small portions of batter with a wet spoon and drop into the hot oil.
Fry, turning occasionally, until deep golden and cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Drain and dust with extra sugar if desired.

recipes.title: Ghanaian Spiced Fried Plantains (Kelewele)
recipes.ingredients:
3 ripe plantains, cubed
1 tsp ground ginger
1/2 tsp cinnamon
1/4 tsp cayenne pepper
2 tbsp brown sugar
Salt to taste
Oil, for frying
Chopped roasted peanuts, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Toss the plantain cubes with ginger, cinnamon, cayenne, brown sugar, and salt until well coated.
Heat about 1 inch of oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the plantains in batches until golden and caramelized, about 3 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels.
Garnish with chopped roasted peanuts.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: South African-Style Oven-Baked Beef Jerky Strips
recipes.ingredients:
1.5 lbs flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain
1/4 cup red wine vinegar
2 tbsp Worcestershire-style sauce
1 tbsp coriander seeds, crushed
1 tsp black pepper
1 tsp salt
1 tbsp brown sugar
recipes.instructions:
Whisk vinegar, Worcestershire-style sauce, crushed coriander, pepper, salt, and brown sugar in a bowl.
Toss the beef strips in the marinade and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.
Preheat the oven to its lowest setting, around 170 F.
Arrange the strips on a wire rack over a baking sheet in a single layer.
Dry in the oven for 3 to 4 hours, flipping once, until firm and dried but still slightly pliable.
Cool completely before storing.

recipes.title: Brazilian Coxinha Chicken Croquettes
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups shredded cooked chicken
1 cup chicken broth
2 tbsp butter
1 onion, minced
1 clove garlic, minced
1 1/2 cups flour
2 oz cream cheese
Salt to taste
2 eggs, beaten
1 cup breadcrumbs
Oil, for frying
recipes.instructions:
Sauté onion and garlic in butter until soft, then stir in shredded chicken and cream cheese, seasoning with salt; set filling aside.
Bring broth to a boil, then stir in flour vigorously until a smooth, thick dough forms; let cool until workable.
Take a portion of dough, flatten in your palm, add a spoonful of chicken filling, and shape into a teardrop, sealing well.
Dip each croquette in beaten egg, then coat in breadcrumbs.
Heat about 2 inches of oil to 350 F and fry until golden, about 4 minutes.
Drain and serve warm.

recipes.title: Mexican Esquites Corn Cups
recipes.ingredients:
4 cups fresh or frozen corn kernels
2 tbsp butter
1/4 cup mayonnaise
1/4 cup crumbled cotija or feta cheese
1 tsp chili powder
Juice of 2 limes
Chopped cilantro, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Melt butter in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook the corn until lightly charred in spots, about 8 minutes.
Transfer the corn to a bowl and stir in mayonnaise while still warm.
Fold in crumbled cheese and chili powder.
Spoon into cups and squeeze lime juice over the top.
Garnish with cilantro and an extra pinch of chili powder.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Mexican Chili-Lime Jicama and Fruit Sticks
recipes.ingredients:
1 jicama, peeled and cut into sticks
2 cups watermelon, cut into sticks
2 mangoes, cut into sticks
1 tsp chili powder
Juice of 2 limes
Pinch of salt
recipes.instructions:
Arrange the jicama, watermelon, and mango sticks on a platter.
Squeeze lime juice evenly over the fruit and jicama.
Sprinkle with chili powder and a pinch of salt.
Toss gently or serve as is for dipping.
Chill 10 minutes before serving for the best flavor.
Serve cold.

recipes.title: Persian Mast-o-Khiar Yogurt Cucumber Dip
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups plain yogurt
1 cucumber, grated and squeezed dry
2 tbsp chopped dill
2 tbsp chopped mint
2 tbsp raisins
2 tbsp chopped walnuts
1 clove garlic, minced
Salt to taste
Pita bread or crackers, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Combine yogurt, grated cucumber, dill, and mint in a bowl.
Stir in raisins, walnuts, and garlic.
Season with salt to taste.
Chill for at least 15 minutes to let the flavors meld.
Serve cold with pita bread or crackers.
Garnish with a drizzle of olive oil if desired.

recipes.title: Georgian Pkhali Walnut Vegetable Spread
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb spinach, blanched and squeezed dry
1 cup walnuts
2 cloves garlic
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
1/4 tsp ground coriander
Salt to taste
Pomegranate seeds, for garnish
Flatbread, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Blanch the spinach until just wilted, then squeeze out as much liquid as possible.
Pulse the spinach with walnuts, garlic, vinegar, coriander, and salt in a food processor until it forms a thick, coarse spread.
Taste and adjust seasoning.
Shape into small mounds on a plate.
Garnish with pomegranate seeds.
Serve with flatbread.

recipes.title: Egyptian Fava Bean Falafel (Ta'ameya)
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups dried split fava beans, soaked overnight and drained
1 small onion, chopped
3 cloves garlic
1 cup chopped parsley
1 cup chopped cilantro
1 tsp ground coriander
1/2 tsp baking powder
Salt to taste
Sesame seeds, for coating
Oil, for frying
recipes.instructions:
Pulse the soaked fava beans with onion, garlic, parsley, cilantro, and coriander in a food processor until finely ground but not pureed.
Stir in baking powder and salt, and let the mixture rest 15 minutes.
Shape into small patties and coat lightly in sesame seeds.
Heat about 2 inches of oil to 350 F and fry the patties until deep golden and crisp, about 3 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve warm with tahini sauce or in pita.

recipes.title: Trinidadian-Style Curried Chickpea Bara Bites
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups flour
1/2 tsp turmeric
1/2 tsp instant yeast
1/2 tsp sugar
1/2 tsp salt
3/4 cup warm water
Oil, for frying
1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, mashed
1 tbsp curry powder
Mango chutney, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Mix flour, turmeric, yeast, sugar, and salt with warm water into a soft, slightly sticky dough; cover and let rise 1 hour.
Stir the mashed chickpeas with curry powder and a pinch of salt.
Pinch off small pieces of dough and flatten into thin rounds.
Fry each round in hot oil until puffed and lightly golden, about 1 minute per side.
Top each fried round with a spoonful of curried chickpeas.
Serve warm with mango chutney.

recipes.title: French Crème Brûlée
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups heavy cream
1 vanilla bean or 1 tsp vanilla extract
5 egg yolks
1/3 cup sugar, plus more for topping
Pinch of salt
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 325 F.
Heat the cream and vanilla in a saucepan until just simmering, then remove from heat.
Whisk egg yolks, sugar, and salt in a bowl, then slowly whisk in the warm cream.
Strain the mixture and divide among ramekins set in a baking dish; fill the dish with hot water halfway up the sides.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes until just set with a slight jiggle in the center.
Chill at least 2 hours, then sprinkle with sugar and caramelize with a torch or under the broiler before serving.

recipes.title: French Madeleines
recipes.ingredients:
2 eggs
1/2 cup sugar
1 tsp vanilla extract
1 cup flour
1 tsp baking powder
Pinch of salt
1/2 cup melted butter, cooled, plus more for the pan
Powdered sugar, for dusting
recipes.instructions:
Whisk eggs, sugar, and vanilla until pale and thick, about 3 minutes.
Fold in flour, baking powder, and salt until just combined, then fold in the melted butter.
Chill the batter at least 30 minutes.
Butter a madeleine pan and spoon batter into each mold, filling about three-quarters full.
Bake at 375 F for 10 to 12 minutes until golden with a slight hump.
Dust with powdered sugar before serving.

recipes.title: Italian Panna Cotta with Berry Sauce
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups heavy cream
1/3 cup sugar
1 tsp vanilla extract
2 tsp unflavored gelatin
3 tbsp cold water
1 1/2 cups mixed berries
2 tbsp sugar, for the sauce
recipes.instructions:
Sprinkle gelatin over cold water and let bloom 5 minutes.
Heat cream, sugar, and vanilla in a saucepan until just simmering, then remove from heat and whisk in the bloomed gelatin until dissolved.
Divide among ramekins or cups and chill at least 4 hours until set.
Simmer the berries with 2 tbsp sugar until softened and syrupy, about 8 minutes, then cool.
Unmold the panna cotta or serve in the cups.
Top with the berry sauce before serving.

recipes.title: Italian Cannoli
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups flour
2 tbsp sugar
2 tbsp butter
1/4 cup marsala wine or orange juice
1 egg white, beaten
Oil, for frying
2 cups ricotta, drained
1/2 cup powdered sugar
1/2 tsp vanilla extract
1/4 cup mini chocolate chips
recipes.instructions:
Mix flour, sugar, and butter until crumbly, then stir in marsala to form a firm dough; chill 30 minutes.
Roll the dough thin and cut into rounds; wrap each around a cannoli tube, sealing the edge with egg white.
Heat about 2 inches of oil to 350 F and fry the shells until golden and blistered, about 2 minutes; cool completely, then slide off the tubes.
Beat ricotta with powdered sugar and vanilla until smooth, then fold in chocolate chips.
Pipe the filling into the cooled shells just before serving.
Dust with extra powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Spanish Torrijas Cinnamon Bread Pudding
recipes.ingredients:
6 thick slices day-old bread
1 1/2 cups milk
1/3 cup sugar, divided
1 cinnamon stick
Zest of 1 lemon
2 eggs, beaten
Oil, for frying
1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, for dusting
recipes.instructions:
Warm the milk with half the sugar, cinnamon stick, and lemon zest until just simmering, then let cool slightly and remove the cinnamon stick and zest.
Soak the bread slices in the spiced milk until softened but not falling apart, about 2 minutes per side.
Dip each soaked slice in beaten egg.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat and fry the slices until golden on both sides, about 2 minutes per side.
Mix remaining sugar with ground cinnamon and dust over the warm torrijas.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Portuguese Pastel de Nata Custard Tarts
recipes.ingredients:
1 sheet puff pastry, thawed
1 cup milk
1/2 cup heavy cream
1/2 cup sugar
3 egg yolks
2 tbsp cornstarch
1 tsp vanilla extract
Cinnamon, for dusting
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 450 F and press small pieces of puff pastry into a muffin tin, forming shells.
Whisk milk, cream, sugar, egg yolks, and cornstarch in a saucepan and cook over medium heat, stirring, until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in vanilla and let cool slightly.
Fill each pastry shell with the custard.
Bake 15 to 18 minutes until the pastry is puffed and the custard is caramelized in spots.
Dust with cinnamon and cool slightly before serving.

recipes.title: Greek Loukoumades Honey Puff Donuts
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups flour
1 tsp instant yeast
1 tbsp sugar
1/2 tsp salt
1 1/4 cups warm water
Oil, for frying
1/2 cup honey
1/4 cup water
1/4 cup chopped walnuts
Ground cinnamon, for dusting
recipes.instructions:
Whisk flour, yeast, sugar, salt, and warm water into a smooth, thick batter; cover and let rise 1 hour until bubbly.
Heat about 2 inches of oil to 350 F.
Drop spoonfuls of batter into the oil and fry until deep golden and puffed, about 3 minutes, turning occasionally.
Simmer honey with water until slightly thinned.
Drain the donuts and toss in the warm honey syrup.
Top with chopped walnuts and a dusting of cinnamon.

recipes.title: Turkish Künefe Cheese Pastry in Syrup
recipes.ingredients:
1 package shredded phyllo (kataifi), thawed
1/2 cup melted butter
2 cups shredded mozzarella
1 cup sugar
1 cup water
1 tsp lemon juice
Chopped pistachios, for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 375 F.
Toss the shredded phyllo with melted butter until evenly coated.
Press half the phyllo into a greased round baking dish, top with shredded mozzarella, then cover with the remaining phyllo, pressing down firmly.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes until deep golden and crisp.
Meanwhile, simmer sugar, water, and lemon juice until slightly thickened into a syrup.
Pour the warm syrup over the baked pastry as soon as it comes out of the oven, then garnish with pistachios and serve warm.

recipes.title: Middle Eastern Ma'amoul Date-Filled Cookies
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups flour
1/2 cup semolina
3/4 cup melted butter
2 tbsp sugar
2 tbsp rosewater or orange blossom water
2 tbsp milk
1 cup pitted dates, chopped
2 tbsp water
1/2 tsp cinnamon
Powdered sugar, for dusting
recipes.instructions:
Mix flour, semolina, melted butter, and sugar until sandy, then stir in rosewater and milk to form a soft dough; let rest 30 minutes.
Simmer the dates with water and cinnamon until soft and paste-like; let cool.
Pinch off pieces of dough, flatten, and fill with a small spoonful of date paste, then seal and shape into a ball or press into a decorative mold.
Arrange on a baking sheet and bake at 350 F for 15 to 18 minutes until pale golden on the bottom.
Cool completely.
Dust with powdered sugar before serving.

recipes.title: Indian Gulab Jamun Fried Milk Dumplings
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup milk powder
1/4 cup flour
1/4 tsp baking soda
2 tbsp melted butter
2 to 3 tbsp milk
Oil, for frying
1 1/2 cups sugar
1 1/2 cups water
4 cardamom pods, crushed
1 tsp rosewater
recipes.instructions:
Mix milk powder, flour, and baking soda, then stir in melted butter and enough milk to form a soft, smooth dough.
Shape into small smooth balls, being careful to avoid cracks.
Simmer sugar, water, and cardamom until slightly syrupy, then stir in rosewater and keep warm.
Heat oil to medium-low, about 300 F, and fry the balls slowly, turning often, until deep golden brown all the way through, about 8 minutes.
Drop the warm fried balls directly into the warm syrup.
Let soak at least 30 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Indian Cardamom Rice Kheer
recipes.ingredients:
1/2 cup basmati rice, rinsed
4 cups whole milk
1/3 cup sugar
4 cardamom pods, crushed
2 tbsp chopped pistachios
2 tbsp raisins
Pinch of saffron (optional)
recipes.instructions:
Combine rice and milk in a heavy pot and bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat to low.
Simmer, stirring frequently to prevent sticking, until the rice is very soft and the milk has thickened, about 30 minutes.
Stir in sugar, cardamom, and saffron, and simmer 5 minutes more.
Stir in raisins and half the pistachios.
Chill or serve warm, topped with remaining pistachios.
Serve in small bowls.

recipes.title: Indian Carrot Halwa (Gajar Halwa)
recipes.ingredients:
2 lbs carrots, grated
4 cups whole milk
1/3 cup sugar
3 tbsp ghee or butter
4 cardamom pods, crushed
2 tbsp chopped almonds
2 tbsp raisins
recipes.instructions:
Simmer the grated carrots with milk in a heavy pot over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the milk has mostly evaporated and the carrots are soft, about 35 minutes.
Stir in sugar and cook until it dissolves and the mixture thickens further, about 5 minutes.
Stir in ghee and cardamom and cook 5 minutes more until glossy.
Fold in raisins.
Garnish with chopped almonds.
Serve warm or chilled.

recipes.title: Japanese Mochi Ice Cream Bites
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup glutinous rice flour (mochiko)
1/4 cup sugar
1 1/4 cups water
Cornstarch, for dusting
1 pint vanilla or fruit ice cream, scooped into small balls and frozen solid
recipes.instructions:
Freeze small scoops of ice cream on a parchment-lined tray until very firm, at least 2 hours.
Whisk rice flour, sugar, and water in a microwave-safe bowl and microwave in 1-minute bursts, stirring between each, until thick and translucent, about 3 minutes total.
Turn the sticky dough out onto a cornstarch-dusted surface and let cool slightly, then divide into small rounds.
Flatten each round, wrap around a frozen ice cream ball, and pinch to seal, dusting off excess cornstarch.
Return immediately to the freezer.
Freeze at least 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Japanese Dorayaki Red Bean Pancakes
recipes.ingredients:
2 eggs
1/3 cup sugar
2 tbsp honey
1 cup flour
1/2 tsp baking powder
3 tbsp water
Oil, for the pan
1 cup sweet red bean paste
recipes.instructions:
Whisk eggs, sugar, and honey until pale, then whisk in flour, baking powder, and water until smooth.
Let the batter rest 15 minutes.
Heat a lightly oiled nonstick skillet over medium-low heat and pour small rounds of batter.
Cook until bubbles form on top, then flip and cook the other side until golden; repeat to make 6 small pancakes.
Spread red bean paste on the flat side of one pancake and sandwich with another.
Repeat with remaining pancakes and serve at room temperature.

recipes.title: Chinese Egg Tarts (Dan Tat)
recipes.ingredients:
1 sheet puff pastry, thawed
3 eggs
1/2 cup sugar
1 cup hot water, cooled slightly
1/2 cup evaporated milk
1/2 tsp vanilla extract
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 400 F and press pieces of puff pastry into a muffin tin to form shells.
Dissolve sugar in the hot water and let cool.
Whisk eggs, evaporated milk, and vanilla into the sugar water, then strain for a smooth custard.
Pour the custard into the pastry shells, filling about three-quarters full.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes until the custard is just set with a slight jiggle and the pastry is golden.
Cool slightly before serving.

recipes.title: Filipino Ube Halaya Purple Yam Jam
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups mashed cooked purple yam (ube)
1 can (14 oz) coconut milk
1 can (14 oz) sweetened condensed milk
3 tbsp butter
1/4 tsp salt
recipes.instructions:
Combine mashed ube, coconut milk, and condensed milk in a saucepan.
Cook over medium-low heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens, about 20 minutes.
Stir in butter and salt and continue cooking until the mixture pulls away from the sides of the pan, about 8 minutes more.
Spoon into a greased dish and smooth the top.
Cool to room temperature, then chill until firm.
Serve as is or spread on bread.

recipes.title: Brazilian Brigadeiro Chocolate Truffle Bites
recipes.ingredients:
1 can (14 oz) sweetened condensed milk
3 tbsp cocoa powder
1 tbsp butter, plus more for hands
Chocolate sprinkles, for coating
recipes.instructions:
Combine condensed milk, cocoa powder, and butter in a saucepan over medium-low heat.
Cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens and pulls away from the sides of the pan, about 12 minutes.
Pour onto a greased plate and let cool completely, about 30 minutes.
Butter your hands lightly and roll the mixture into small balls.
Roll each ball in chocolate sprinkles to coat.
Serve in mini paper cups.

recipes.title: Mexican Tres Leches Cake
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup flour
1 tsp baking powder
5 eggs, separated
1 cup sugar, divided
1/3 cup milk
1 tsp vanilla extract
1 can (12 oz) evaporated milk
1 can (14 oz) sweetened condensed milk
1/2 cup heavy cream
1 cup whipped cream, for topping
recipes.instructions:
Preheat the oven to 350 F and grease a baking dish.
Whisk flour and baking powder in a bowl.
Beat egg yolks with half the sugar until pale, then stir in milk and vanilla and fold in the flour mixture.
Beat egg whites with remaining sugar to soft peaks, then fold into the batter.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean; let cool, then poke holes all over.
Whisk evaporated milk, condensed milk, and heavy cream, and pour over the cake, letting it soak in; top with whipped cream before serving.

recipes.title: Argentinian Alfajores Dulce de Leche Cookies
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups flour
1/2 cup cornstarch
1 tsp baking powder
1/2 cup butter, softened
1/2 cup sugar
2 egg yolks
1 tsp vanilla extract
1 cup dulce de leche
Shredded coconut, for coating (optional)
recipes.instructions:
Whisk flour, cornstarch, and baking powder in a bowl.
Beat butter and sugar until fluffy, then beat in egg yolks and vanilla.
Mix in the dry ingredients until a soft dough forms; chill 30 minutes.
Roll the dough to 1/4 inch thickness and cut into small rounds; bake at 350 F for 10 to 12 minutes until pale golden on the bottom.
Cool completely, then sandwich pairs of cookies together with a spoonful of dulce de leche.
Roll the edges in shredded coconut if desired.

recipes.title: Scandinavian Cardamom Buns (Kardemummabullar)
recipes.ingredients:
3 cups flour
1/4 cup sugar
1 tsp instant yeast
1 tsp ground cardamom
1/2 tsp salt
1 cup warm milk
1/4 cup melted butter
3 tbsp softened butter
2 tbsp sugar, for filling
1 tsp cardamom, for filling
1 egg, beaten, for brushing
Pearl sugar, for topping
recipes.instructions:
Mix flour, sugar, yeast, cardamom, and salt, then stir in warm milk and melted butter to form a soft dough.
Knead 8 minutes until smooth, then let rise 1 hour until doubled.
Roll the dough into a rectangle and spread with softened butter, then sprinkle with sugar and cardamom.
Fold and slice into strips, then twist and knot each strip into a bun shape.
Let the shaped buns rise 30 minutes, then brush with egg and sprinkle with pearl sugar.
Bake at 400 F for 15 to 18 minutes until golden.
